jobs.title: Project Manager - Pharmacy Mergers & Acquisitions
jobs.description:
**It’s not just a job. It’s a mission.**

Altruix is a high-touch pharmacy dedicated to serving behavioral health and intellectual and developmental disability populations. Through our pharmacy expertise, and specialized packaging, we promote medication adherence and improve patient outcomes. Our services help clients take medications as prescribed while reducing administrative burden for providers. Altruix customers achieve measurable results, including 90% adherence rates and a 40% reduction in ER and hospital-related costs. Learn more at www.altruix.com.

Altruix is seeking a hands-on **Project Manager - Pharmacy Mergers & Acquisitions** to lead the execution of pharmacy acquisitions, integrations, De Novo builds, and relocations. This role translates approved growth opportunities into actionable project plans and drives execution from pre-close or initial planning through launch, stabilization, and transition to ongoing operations. The Project Manager coordinates cross-functional teams, maintains accountability for milestones and deliverables, identifies and escalates risks, and supports multiple concurrent projects while strengthening Altruix’s repeatable M&A and De Novo implementation processes.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Own integrated project plans, timelines, milestones, dependencies, budgets, and deliverables, ensuring clear ownership and accountability across workstreams
* Lead project kickoffs, workstream reviews, and readiness meetings; document decisions and drive timely resolution of action items, risks, and dependencies
* Maintain project dashboards, risk and issue tracking, and leadership reporting, clearly communicating status, decisions needed, and recovery plans
* Coordinate cross-functional work across Operations, Clinical and Quality, Legal and Compliance, Finance, HR, IT, Revenue Cycle, Payer, Licensing, Facilities, Procurement, Sales, Marketing, 340B, and Logistics

  

**M&A Integration:**

* Build and manage transaction-specific integration plans based on deal structure, locations, licensing, payer enrollment, workforce, systems, contracts, and operational requirements
* Coordinate seller information requests and pre-close planning in accordance with Legal-approved access and confidentiality requirements
* Drive Day 1 readiness and post-close integration through stabilization, coordinating employee onboarding, financial and billing continuity, procurement, technology, supplier transitions, communications, and operating workflows
* Coordinate system migrations, testing, cutover, contingency planning, and operational support to minimize disruption to patient and client service

  

**De Novo Builds and Pharmacy Relocations:**

* Translate approved opportunities into project scope, budgets, launch plans, timelines, and readiness requirements, escalating material changes to cost, timing, staffing, or scope
* Coordinate site selection, lease and facility activities, permitting, construction, licensing, equipment, technology, staffing, supplier setup, inventory, and operational readiness with functional owners and external partners
* Manage pharmacy relocations and Construction De Novo launches, ensuring licensing, payer, staffing, technology, patient transition, and operational dependencies are addressed before opening

  

**Launch Readiness and Continuous Improvement:**

* Coordinate functional readiness signoffs and escalate unresolved regulatory, patient-safety, payer, security, financial, or operational risks before launch
* Lead launch support, issue resolution, stabilization reviews, and formal handoff to ongoing Operations
* Monitor project performance against approved scope, schedule, budget, and operating objectives; capture lessons learned and continuously improve implementation playbooks and templates

  

**Success Metrics:**

* Success is demonstrated through reliable milestone delivery, clear cross-functional accountability, controlled scope and budget, launch readiness, continuity of patient and client service, effective issue resolution, and successful transition to ongoing operations

  

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, healthcare administration, project management, or related field, or equivalent relevant experience
* 5+ years of project management or implementation experience leading complex, cross-functional projects involving multiple departments, vendors, or locations
* Experience in healthcare, pharmacy operations, acquisitions/integrations, facility openings, or other regulated environments strongly preferred
* Strong planning, facilitation, communication, problem-solving, and follow-through skills with the ability to influence across functional teams
* Proficiency with Excel and project management tools, including schedules, dashboards, budgets, and action tracking

* PMP or equivalent certification preferred
* Behavioral health or long-term care pharmacy, pharmacy system conversions, construction coordination, and/or 340B experience preferred

  

**Travel Expectations:**

* Travel is required for site assessments, acquisition transitions, construction milestones, and pharmacy launches. Occasional work outside normal business hours may be required during critical transitions

  

**BENEFITS:**

* Salary of $115,000 to $125,000 based on experience
* Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, and Long-Term Disability
* 401(k) program
* Paid time off
* Paid holidays

  

**EEOC:**

Altruix is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate in recruiting, hiring, placement, training, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfers, leaves of absence, compensation, or other employment practices based on any protected characteristic under federal, state, or local law. Altruix is a drug-free workplace and requires pre-employment drug and alcohol testing as a condition of employment.

jobs.title: Project Manager, Implementations
jobs.description:
**About Technosylva**

Technosylva is a global leader in wildfire and extreme weather risk mitigation software. The Company’s market-leading solutions, enhanced by AI and machine learning capabilities, provide real-time and predictive insights to support electric utility, insurance and government agency customers.

Technosylva has provided critical solutions for the past 26 years. In 2022 the organization entered a period of significant growth and transformation with investment from TA Associates, a leading growth PE firm, scaling to about 225 employees and offering its product in over 10 countries. In 2024 General Atlantic, a leading global growth investor, announced a strategic growth investment in Technosylva to support the company in its mission.

**Role Overview**

The Project Manager will work closely with the customer delivery team, product managers, implementation leads and the other project managers in a dynamic environment across multiple time zones applying conventional project management methods to coordinate the delivery and implementation of Technosylva’s subscription software products. Experience with managing milestones, deliverables, stakeholder communication is required.

**Responsibilities**

* Be accountable for the full life cycle of successful customer projects (Sales to Customer Support/Customer Success) including new implementations, updates, Change Requests and other.
* Work with and lead Technosylva team members to develop project plans and timelines, identify project tasks, and coordinate completion of project deliverables and outcomes.
* Coordinate timelines and deliverable milestones with the Technosylva technical teams and customers.
* Support Technosylva senior leadership and project leads with maintaining project schedules and communicating status of project milestones, upcoming deliverables, dependencies, and risks and issues with leadership, project leads and clients.
* Coordinate and plan projects and tasks using company approved software, such as Microsoft Office, Google Docs, Notion and Jira.
* Identify project, deliverable, and software release conflicts across projects and clients, supporting Technosylva senior leadership to revise project schedules and communicate with clients as needed.
* Proactively seek opportunities to implement improvements in the project management process and deployment pipeline.
* Measure project performance using project management best practices methodology and techniques.
* Closely collaborate with clients, assuring project success and customer satisfaction.
* Provide leadership by motivating team members to meet project goals, adhering to their responsibilities and project milestones.
* Work with Technosylva senior management and product leads to identify project opportunities and provide custom solutions to meet client needs.
* Support Technosylva senior management with strategic planning.

  

**Requirements**

**Required**

* Project management experience in a SaaS company, with a track record of delivering complex initiatives on time and within budget.
* Experience working in wildland fire, forestry, electric utilities or related discipline.
* Experience with project management software programs such as Smartsheets, Notion and Jira (or equivalent).
* Proficiency utilizing the MS Office Suite and Google Apps.
* Problem-solving ability with excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills.
* Demonstrated success in working remotely, successfully completing multiple complex projects simultaneously on time and within budget.
* Well organized, self-motivated, upbeat, creative, resourceful and accountable.
* Demonstrate strong leadership, management, and collaboration qualities.

  

**Preferred**

* Experience managing or utilizing the Agile development process.
* Formal project management training.
* Bachelor’s degree in a technical field such as engineering, computer science, and/or natural science.
* Valid PMP designation from the Project Management Institute (PMI) is an asset.

jobs.title: Staff Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
**About OpenLoop**
------------------

OpenLoop was co-founded by CEO, Dr. Jon Lensing, and COO, Christian Williams, with the vision to bring care anywhere. Our telehealth support solutions are thoughtfully designed to streamline and simplify go-to-market care delivery for companies offering meaningful virtual support to patients across an expansive array of specialties, in all 50 states.

**About the Role**
------------------

OpenLoop’s mission is to bring care anywhere by powering telehealth solutions at scale. Our Technical Program Management team turns business vision into structured, measurable execution, bringing operational rigor, predictability, and scale to how OpenLoop plans and ships. We’re hiring a Staff Technical Program Manager to lead high-impact, cross-functional programs that directly support company OKRs and strategic priorities.

This is a senior-level individual contributor role responsible for translating business vision into structured, executable technical programs. You will partner closely with Engineering, Product, and business stakeholders, run Agile delivery across engineering teams, and make sure every initiative is tied to measurable outcomes.

You will help scale the TPM function at OpenLoop by standardizing Agile and practices, defining reporting cadences, and providing delivery metrics that improve how teams plan and ship. You will present in stakeholder and leadership meetings, with C-level visibility and meaningful ownership.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Own and drive execution of complex, cross-functional technical initiatives tied directly to company OKRs.
* Translate business requirements into clearly defined technical programs and actionable requirements for engineering teams.
* Ensure every request from business stakeholders aligns with company objectives and measurable outcomes.
* Make prioritization and tradeoff decisions in partnership with Engineering and business leaders, negotiating across scope, timelines, and impact.
* Produce status reports and updates tailored to the audience: executive summaries for leadership, detailed delivery views for engineering, and updates for business partners.
* Run Agile ceremonies and coordinate delivery across multiple engineering teams, and cross-team planning and dependency management.
* Proactively identify risks, manage dependencies, and remove blockers.
* Use metrics and retrospective findings to find bottlenecks and improve team efficiency, velocity, and communication.

**Who You Are**
---------------

### **Required Qualifications**

* 6+ years of experience in Technical Program Management or equivalent strategic technical role.
* Deep working knowledge of Agile software development, such as Scrum and the Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe).
* Strong technical fluency (not required to be an engineer) with the ability to understand systems architecture, APIs, integrations, and technical dependencies.
* Demonstrated experience translating complex systems into business-friendly language.
* Proven experience driving programs tied to OKRs and measurable business outcomes.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of presenting to senior stakeholders and executives.
* Experience writing status reports and program updates tailored to different audiences, from executives to engineering teams.
* Experience defining and using delivery metrics (velocity, predictability, cycle time, health indicators) to improve team performance.
* Strong prioritization and decision-making skills with the ability to operate autonomously.
* Experience aligning and influencing cross-functional stakeholders.
* Hands-on experience using **Jira** and other project management tools to manage cross-functional delivery at scale.
* Experience structuring backlogs, defining epics and milestones, and creating executive-ready reporting dashboards.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), or SAFe certification (e.g., SAFe Scrum Master, SAFe Release Train Engineer, SAFe Agilist).
* Experience in healthcare, health tech, virtual care, care delivery platforms, or healthcare operations.
* Experience with clinical, pharmacy, or technical integrations.
* Experience working in fast-growing or globally distributed teams.

**Our Benefits**
----------------

In addition, for salaried positions you would also be eligible for:

* Medical, Dental, and Vision plans
* Flexible Spending/Health Savings Accounts
* Flexible PTO
* 401(k) + Company Match
* Life Insurance, Pet insurance, and more

**Our Company**
---------------

We have a relatively flat organizational structure here at OpenLoop. Everyone is encouraged to bring ideas to the table and make things happen. This fits in well with our core values of Autonomy, Competence and Belonging, as we want everyone to feel empowered and supported to do their best work.

Sound like a good fit? We’d love to meet you.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Daxko builds the software that powers fitness, wellness, and community organizations—everything from member management and payments to digital engagement and analytics. From small studios to the largest associations, we help thousands of fitness businesses streamline operations, enhance member experiences, and drive sustainable revenue growth.

The Project Manager leads implementation of Daxko's software solutions for new customers, owning the experience from kickoff to launch. You'll manage multiple projects at once, keep customers and internal teams aligned, and make sure every client gets a smooth path to going live. This role follows Daxko's established implementation methodology, so you'll have a clear framework to work within while bringing your own judgment to each project.

**What you'll do**

* Own end-to-end implementation for small and mid-size customer projects, from kickoff through launch
* Launch each assigned customer within four months of project start
* Run weekly check-ins with customers and internal teams to report status and flag risk early
* Partner with Daxko's ETL Data team to support customer data analysis and resolve data questions
* Keep project documentation current and useful for the teams relying on it
* Escalate problems early, with context, so they get solved before they grow
* Travel to customer sites as needed (about 25% of the time)

**What you'll bring**

* 1 to 2 years of experience in project management, implementation, or a related customer-facing role
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects without losing detail
* Clear, confident communication with both customers and internal teams
* A problem-solving mindset: you can size up a complex issue, weigh options, and act
* Comfort self-directing and prioritizing your own workload

**Nice to have**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, or a related field
* CAPM certification

Daxko is dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce. We are committed to diversity in the broadest sense, including thought and perspective, age, ability, nationality, ethnicity, orientation, and gender. The skills, perspectives, ideas, and experiences of all of our team members contribute to the vitality and success of our purpose and values.

We truly care for our team members, and this is reflected through our offices, benefits, and great perks. These benefits are only for our full-time team members.

Some of our favorites include:

Flexible paid time off

* ️ Affordable health, dental, and vision insurance options

Monthly fitness reimbursement

401(k) matching

New-Parent Paid Leave

Casual work environments

Flexible work - remote & hybrid

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

#LI-Remote

Where you fall within the compensation range is based on how you demonstrate the skills and competencies needed for the role. We typically reserve the upper half of our compensation bands for team members who have grown within Daxko. In addition to base salary, some roles may be eligible for bonuses, commissions, or other performance-based incentives. We also offer a comprehensive benefits package, recognition programs, and plenty of opportunities to grow your career with us.

The pay range for this role is $59,258 – $82,961 per year.

DailyPay is the leader in On-Demand Pay, helping employers modernize how people get their pay. DailyPay serves more than 1,900 employers and over 6 million employees, including many of the world's most recognized brands. By providing real-time access to earned pay and financial wellness tools, DailyPay helps employees manage their finances and helps employers attract and retain talent. DailyPay is helping define the future of pay, where money moves at the speed of work. Learn more at DailyPay's Press Center.

The Senior Implementation Manager will be responsible for managing the entire implementation lifecycle — from pre-sales support through post-launch handoff.

Our team embraces modern tooling and AI-assisted workflows to deliver smarter, faster implementations — and we’re looking for someone who is naturally curious about emerging technology and excited to use it as a force multiplier in their day-to-day work.

Success in this role will rely on a combination of strong client and project management skills, technical proficiency, executive presence, and the ability to manage the details while seeing the bigger picture. We are looking for an out-of-the-box thinker who can execute a high volume of projects.

**Required Skills and Experience:**

  

* Bachelor’s Degree (or commensurate experience)
* 12+ years of experience work in dynamic customer delivery environments (2 years of experience may be removed for a masters degree)

**Program Manager**

**About Crowned Grace International**

Crowned Grace International (CGINTL) is a Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned and Woman-Owned Small Business that delivers management consulting, workforce transformation, and mission support to the Department of Defense, federal civilian agencies, and Fortune 1000 clients. CGINTL holds GSA Multiple Award Schedule and OASIS+ contracts, is ISO 9001:2015 certified, and maintains internal controls rated Adequate by DCAA. Our purpose is captured in our motto: Accelerating Mission-Ready Capabilities.

**The Opportunity**

CGINTL is building a team to help a federal civilian agency's Office of Acquisitions close a backlog of expired contracts, including cost-reimbursement contracts, IDIQs, and fixed-price and time-and-materials awards. You will lead the program end to end: setting the closeout plan and burn-down targets with the Contracting Officers, building and managing the team, removing blockers, and making sure every package that reaches the Government is complete, compliant, and ready for signature.

**What You'll Do**

* **Program leadership and Government liaison:** Acts as the primary point of contact for the COR and Contracting Officers. Leads kickoff, weekly status meetings, and monthly program reviews; documents Government direction and decisions.
* **Closeout planning and burn-down management:** Develops and maintains the integrated closeout plan. Works with the COs to prioritize actions by age, contract type, dollar value, and risk; sets burn-down targets and forecasts completion.
* **Staffing and personnel management:** Recruits, onboards, and assigns staff; manages badging and PIV processing; evaluates performance; directs any teammate; adjusts staffing as backlog volumes and CO priorities change.
* **Risk, issue, and escalation management:** Identifies blockers such as missing contractor releases, unsettled indirect rates, unreconciled unliquidated obligations, and non-responsive contractors; escalates each with a recommended course of action.
* **Quality and compliance oversight:** Owns the Quality Control Plan; enforces the inherently governmental boundary, safeguarding of contractor proprietary and personal information, personal conflict-of-interest requirements, and limitations on subcontracting.
* **Contract administration and reporting:** Delivers monthly status reports and contract deliverables, reviews invoices, and manages transition-in and transition-out.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in business, public administration, or a related discipline.
* 10 years of directly related experience, including 5 years managing federal acquisition, contract administration, or acquisition-support programs.
* Project Management Professional (PMP). (required)
* Thorough knowledge of FAR Parts 4 and 42 closeout requirements and the roles of the CO, COR, and contractor
* Ability to lead multi-disciplinary teams to measurable production targets
* Skill in briefing senior Government officials and resolving issues across organizational lines
* Proficiency with project scheduling, metrics, and status reporting tools
* Ability to obtain and maintain a federal background investigation and PIV credential

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree
* FAC-C (Professional) or DoD Contracting Professional certification
* Prior management of a contract closeout or acquisition operations support program

**Work Environment**

Virtual position. May require travel to outreach events and occasional work outside normal hours.

**Our Culture**

At CGINTL, everyone is a Leader. We hire to, develop toward, and hold one another accountable to seven Core Values: IntegrityTrust; Credibility; Accountability ("No Excuses Here"); Continuous Improvement; Action Orientation; Caring for the Team, the Client, and the Business; and Marketplace Ministry.

jobs.description:
**Position Summary**
--------------------

Odyssey has an exciting opportunity for a **Senior** **AOC Operations & Technology** **Program Manager** providing support to the Command, Control, Communications (C3C)/Kessel Run division.

  

Kessel Run is revolutionizing how the United States Air Force develops, deploys, and operates mission-critical software. We are seeking an experienced AOC Operations & Technology Program Manager to serve as the critical bridge between commercial airline operations control practices and military Air Operations Center (AOC) modernization

  

This is a full time remote position.

  

**\*\* Position Contingent upon Contract Award\*\***

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

In this role, you will leverage deep commercial airline industry expertise—specifically from Airline Operations Control Centers (OCC / NOCC)—to advise and guide software product teams, operational leaders, and system architects. You will help translate battle-tested commercial concepts such as Collaborative Decision Making (CDM), real-time disruption management, automated flight dispatch, and predictive resource allocation into modern, cloud-native command and control (C2) software capabilities for the warfighter.

  

**Duties include, but not limited to:**

**Commercial Aviation Practices & Operational Strategy**

* Champion the adoption of proven commercial airline Operations Control Center (OCC) processes, metrics, and workflows across Air Operations Center functional areas.
* Introduce and adapt commercial Collaborative Decision Making (CDM) frameworks and Air Traffic Management (ATM) flow strategies to military airspace planning and dynamic air tasking.
* Advise leadership on modern disruption management (irregular operations / IROP) models, crew/fleet recovery algorithms, and slot management concepts to improve operational resilience and sortie execution.
  

**Product Roadmapping & Technology Modernization**

* Partner closely with product managers, software engineers, and user-experience (UX) designers to translate operational pain points into clear user stories, functional requirements, and product roadmaps.
* Facilitate user-centered design sessions and workflow mapping between operational controllers, planners, and software development teams within an agile/DevSecOps development cycle.
* Evaluate emerging commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) airline software, optimization solvers, and cloud architectures to determine feasibility for integration into modern AOC software suites.
  

**Operational Metrics & Performance Optimization**

* Establish and monitor data-driven operational KPIs modeled after commercial aviation standards (e.g., departure punctuality, turnaround time optimization, asset utilization, and fuel/route efficiency).
* Utilize operational telemetry and user feedback to identify planning bottlenecks, track system adoption, and quantify the operational impact of newly deployed software features.
* Oversee capacity planning and operational modeling to support both day-to-day operations and surge tasking requirements.
  

**Stakeholder Collaboration & Change Management**

* Serve as the primary operational liaison between software product teams, operational military leadership, acquisition authorities, and industry technology partners.

**Title:** Security Analyst | **Location:** US Remote | **Reports To:** Sr. Director of InfoSec and IT  
**Compensation Range:** $110000 - $140000

**About Private Health Management**

Private Health Management guides patients and families through the chaos and complexity of serious medical care, for cancer and beyond. As an independent advocate and trusted partner during healthcare's most challenging moments, our team of experts work alongside physicians to orchestrate the best treatment, advocacy, and support to deliver measurably better outcomes.

Everyone deserves great care. We make sure they get it.

**About the Role**

The Security Analyst is a hands-on member of the InfoSec team within PHM's Technology Department. This role will own significant portions of the day-to-day security operations program, including security monitoring, incident response, access governance, vulnerability management, vendor risk, audit evidence, and cloud and SaaS security.

This role is designed to add execution depth to a growing security program and reduce dependence on a single person for both strategy and operations. The analyst will have meaningful ownership and broad exposure across the security function, with the opportunity to improve how issues are prevented, investigated, documented, and resolved.

**What** **You'll** **Accomplish**

* Establish a continuous compliance evidence process where recurring control activities have clear owners and due dates, evidence is captured as work happens, and SOC 2 Type II and HITRUST i1 assessments can be supported without a last-minute evidence sprint.

* Reduce recurring misdirection incidents by using observed patterns to improve DLP and external send controls and by partnering with owning teams to address upstream workflow causes.

* Build reliable access governance by verifying provisioning and deprovisioning, identifying and removing dormant or excessive access on a recurring cycle, reviewing privileged access on schedule, and validating MSP handoffs rather than assuming completion.

**How** **You'll** **Spend Your Days**

**Security Monitoring and Investigation**

Investigate detections and suspicious activity across CrowdStrike Falcon, Okta, Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Microsoft Purview, Zscaler, Box, KnowBe4, and related systems. Form hypotheses, work through incomplete telemetry, document findings clearly, and escalate when business or legal judgment is required.

**Risk and Remediation**

Prioritize vulnerabilities, security findings, access issues, and control gaps based on exploitability and business impact. Drive remediation with internal teams, the MSP, and vendors even when you do not directly control the work.

**Security Operations and Governance**

Maintain provisioning verification, access reviews, vendor security reviews, DLP monitoring, security ticket workflows, and recurring control activities. Help strengthen runbooks and operating processes so knowledge becomes repeatable and self service.

**Detection, Cloud, and Compliance**

Improve detection coverage and logging across CrowdStrike NG SIEM and other platforms, support cloud security work in Azure and AKS, and maintain audit ready evidence for SOC 2 and HITRUST. Contribute to vendor assessments, security terms, and AI policy monitoring as needed.

**What You Bring to the Table**

**Required**

* Strong investigative reasoning. You can work from incomplete information, form and test hypotheses, determine what matters first, and make sound escalation decisions even when ideal logs or context are unavailable.

* Practical risk prioritization. You evaluate exploitability, business impact, exposure, and operational reality rather than relying only on severity scores or checklists.

* Clear written communication. You can produce incident documentation and audit evidence that others can rely on, and you can translate technical findings into concise communication for nontechnical leaders.

* Strong ownership and judgment. You can drive work across teams and vendors that do not report to you, follow through when progress stalls, make appropriate operational decisions independently, and recognize when a determination belongs with security leadership or Legal.

**Nice to Have**

* An automation instinct and experience using tools such as Python or PowerShell to eliminate repetitive operational work.

* Detection engineering depth, including writing and tuning queries and thinking about coverage against adversary behavior rather than alert volume alone.

* Prior experience as a systems administrator or IT generalist, with practical knowledge of identity, endpoints, SaaS integrations, securing AI platforms, and how remediation affects real environments.

* Experience with audit or GRC programs, SOC 2 evidence review, vendor security assessments, CAIQ responses, DPA or BAA security terms, or critical review of third party assurance reports.

The target base salary for this position is $110000 - $140000.

This base salary is only a part of a total compensation package that also includes: health/dental/vision benefits, annual cash incentive program, 401k with match, flexible PTO, PHM for PHM (our services for you and your dependents) and other benefits. Individual pay may vary from the target range as a number of factors including market forces, experience, location, disparities in market data and other relevant business considerations may all factor into final compensation.

This is a remote role requiring that you live in and physically perform all work in the United States.

jobs.title: Security Analyst
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

BCC Software develops innovative software and data solutions that power critical customer communications for organizations across North America. With more than 45 years of industry leadership, we combine deep postal expertise with modern technology to help our customers streamline operations, improve efficiency, and drive growth.

 **Job Description**

The Security Analyst supports BCC Software’s cybersecurity program by defining, validating, and reporting on security controls to protect company assets and sensitive information and reduce cyber risk. This role uses recognized frameworks, third-party audits, and defined service-level agreements to guide security governance, operations, and continuous improvement. IT owns day-to-day system administration.

Essential Functions

* Strengthen identity security using Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, phishing-resistant MFA, and Privileged Identity Management (PIM).
* Integrate, deploy, support, and continuously improve security tools and the Microsoft security stack, including Defender XDR, Microsoft Sentinel and KQL, and Microsoft Intune security capabilities.
* Oversee the managed detection and response (MDR) provider, including escalations, tuning, and service reviews.
* Own the vulnerability and exposure management program, establish remediation SLAs, verify remediation evidence, and report status, exceptions, and risk trends.
* Lead incident response and serve as the primary security contact during incidents; maintain playbooks, escalation procedures, tabletop exercises, and on-call expectations.
* Establish Azure cloud security guardrails for landing zones and oversee Defender for Cloud, Azure Policy, and related cloud security controls.
* Own data protection controls through Microsoft Purview sensitivity labeling and data loss prevention for customer data and personally identifiable information.
* Enforce the AI Usage Policy and govern risks associated with Microsoft Copilot oversharing, shadow AI, and SaaS discovery.
* Manage third-party and vendor security risk, including due diligence, recurring reviews, evidence collection, and customer security questionnaires.
* Manage security ticket workflows for access reviews and phishing reports; define response SLAs and verify supporting evidence.
* Create and maintain security documentation, including policies, the risk register, incident response records, and audit evidence.
* Align the security program with NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) 2.0, CIS Controls, SOC 2 Type II, USPS licensing security requirements, and cyber insurance attestations.
* Validate ransomware resilience through evidence of immutable backups and recurring recovery testing.
* Manage the security awareness training program and work across teams to reinforce security policies, controls, monitoring, and best practices.
* Provide backup support for network, server, and cloud administration as needed, without assuming primary responsibility for routine administration.
* Assist with security-related budgets and purchases.
* Serve as liaison with security and IT professionals at BlueCrest and Platinum.
* Develop and manage security reports and dashboards for management.

  
**Qualifications**  

* 5+ years of cybersecurity operations experience or equivalent experience.
* Strong understanding of secure network architecture and networking principles.
* Knowledge of Windows, macOS, and Linux operating systems.
* Hands-on security experience with Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Azure, including Entra ID, Conditional Access, phishing-resistant MFA, PIM, Defender XDR, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Intune security capabilities, Defender for Cloud, and Azure Policy.
* Ability to review the security configuration and risk posture of network infrastructure, including Juniper and Cisco switches and Fortinet firewalls.
* Experience supporting SOC 2 Type II audits, including control validation and evidence collection.
* Familiarity with NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) 2.0 and CIS Controls.
* PowerShell scripting and KQL query skills for security operations, investigation, and automation.
* Ability to respond quickly to critical problems and willingness to participate in an on-call rotation.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to define security SLAs, evaluate evidence, report risk, and communicate requirements to technical and business stakeholders.
* Understanding of adversary tactics and tooling (MITRE ATTACK; e.g., Cobalt Strike and Mimikatz) sufficient to detect, hunt, and validate controls.
* One or more relevant security certifications are preferred, including Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst Associate (SC-200), Azure Security Engineer Associate (AZ-500), Identity and Access Administrator Associate (SC-300), or CISSP.

  
**Additional Information**

**Work Location**

This position may be based anywhere within the United States. Occasional travel is expected to data center facilities, customer locations, or BCC Software headquarters in Rochester, New York. Candidates who live within driving distance of the Rochester office are strongly preferred.  
  
**Physical Demands**

This is primarily an office-based role requiring extended periods of sitting and frequent use of hands for typing, writing, and operating standard office equipment. The position requires effective verbal and written communication. Occasional standing, walking, bending, reaching, or lifting of office supplies or small equipment up to 25 pounds may be required. Visual acuity sufficient for reading, computer work, and document review is necessary. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.

**Position Type and Expected Hours of Work**

This is a full-time, exempt position. Standard hours are Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Eastern Time, with time zone flexibility for employe

**Who are we?**

Smarsh empowers its customers to manage risk and unleash intelligence in their digital communications. Our growing community of over 6500 organizations in regulated industries counts on Smarsh every day to help them spot compliance, legal or reputational risks in 80+ communication channels before those risks become regulatory fines or headlines. Relentless innovation has fueled our journey to consistent leadership recognition from analysts like Gartner and Forrester, and our sustained, aggressive growth has landed Smarsh in the annual Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing American companies since 2008.

**About the role**

Smarsh is looking for a Senior Marketing Analyst to build the data foundation that marketing and go-to-market (GTM) teams run on — and that our AI tools will increasingly depend on. AI assistants and agents can only answer revenue questions reliably when the data model beneath them is clean, governed, and well defined. This role owns that layer for marketing: from source-system connectors and Snowflake, through dbt models and a governed semantic layer, to the dashboards, analysis, and AI-driven insight that leadership uses to make decisions.

You'll set the measurement and data roadmap, not just execute against it. You'll partner with Marketing Operations, Demand Generation, Sales/Revenue Operations, Customer Success, and IT/Data Architecture, and you'll be a trusted analytical partner to marketing and GTM leadership on planning, pipeline, and growth strategy.

### **How will you contribute?**

**AI-ready data foundation**

* Design and build an AI-ready data foundation for marketing and GTM: governed dbt models and a semantic layer (e.g., dbt Semantic Layer, LookML, Omni) with consistent metric definitions that both people and AI tools can query.
* Prioritize foundation domains in partnership with RevOps and IT — starting with marketing performance and attribution, and connecting to pipeline, account hierarchy, and customer retention data.
* Build validation and testing frameworks (data tests, reconciliation checks, and accuracy evaluation of AI-generated answers) so AI assistants and agents return answers leadership can trust.
* Partner with Marketing Operations and IT to deploy and improve AI tools (e.g., Claude, BI-native AI agents) that answer recurring marketing and pipeline questions in a self-serve way.

**Data architecture & engineering**

jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst, Network Optimization
jobs.description:
Brightside Health delivers life-saving virtual mental healthcare to everyone who needs it. We are powered by proprietary AI, purpose-built technology, a world-class clinician network, and a care model that rivals the best of in-person treatment. When combined with precision psychiatry and leading-edge therapeutic techniques, we’re able to improve outcomes for those with mild-to-severe clinical depression, anxiety, and other mood disorders. Our innovative approach has earned recognition from leading publications such as Healthline, Fortune, and Forbes, naming us 'Most Comprehensive,' and 'Best Online Therapy for Anxiety and Depression.'

We take an action-oriented, purposeful approach with everything we do and seek out team members who value collaboration and thoughtful prioritization. As a result, our organization is looking for the brightest and most innovative talent in the industry. We can promise you that, as a member of the Brightside team, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate alongside smart and driven people while growing your professional skills.

Brightside is looking for a versatile Senior Data Analyst to join our Data Analytics team and embed with our Network product and operations teams. The provider network is the backbone of our care model, and this role sits at the center of it. Your work will shape the clinician experience and, through it, the quality and accessibility of care our patients receive. You'll report to the Senior Director of Analytics and work most closely with the central Network product team.

Think of this as the analytical engine behind a healthy, balanced network. You'll help us anticipate where patient need is heading and make sure we have the right clinicians in the right places to meet it. That means understanding the full clinician lifecycle, from recruitment and onboarding through retention, and connecting it to the things that matter most to patients: quality of care, strong therapeutic relationships, and a smooth path to getting scheduled. Along the way, you'll work with Product and Engineering to test new ideas and measure what actually moves the needle.

You'll be a trusted thought partner to leaders across Network, Clinical, and Product, turning messy, multi-source data into clear direction on where to invest next. You'll also help shape how our team works, contributing to a modern data foundation where governed metrics and AI-assisted analysis make good decisions faster for everyone.

The best fit is someone who pairs deep technical craft with sound business judgment, who is energized by ambiguity, and who can explain a complex analysis in a way that gets people to act.

**What you’ll do in this role:**

* Build and maintain the forecast model for network capacity vs. patient demand across all 50 state markets and multiple clinical care programs, and use it to guide where and when we invest in supply
* Partner with Network Ops and Clinical Talent to deliver measurement and insights that support clinician recruitment and onboarding and strengthen retention
* Develop frameworks to measure the impact of clinical quality, therapeutic alliance, and patient panel balance at both the clinician and market level
* Partner with Product and Engineering to design and run experiments on patient scheduling experiences and clinician-facing product features
* Serve as the primary analytics partner for the Network POD, explaining the drivers behind changes in performance metrics, tying them to OKRs, clinical, and financial outcomes, and presenting insights and experiment results to leadership
* Join a Data team building AI-powered analytics infrastructure that governs metric reliability and unlocks deeper analysis, including developing and documenting the data models behind KPI reporting and agentic analytics
* Solve ambiguous problems creatively with systematic, scalable solutions

**Requirements:**

* 8+ years of analytics experience, with a Master's degree or equivalent practical experience
* Expert-level SQL and data modeling in a cloud data warehouse (ex: BigQuery/GCP), with a track record of writing clean, performant, well-documented code
* Hands-on experience developing and scaling a dbt project, including testing, documentation, and governed metric definitions
* Strong forecasting and econometric modeling skills, ideally paired with operations research methods (capacity planning, supply-demand optimization, resource allocation)
* Experience designing, running, and interpreting A/B tests and other experiments, including knowing when a clean experiment isn't possible and what to do instead
* Proficiency with data visualization tools (ex: Tableau) to build dashboards and tell clear stories with data
* Fluency with AI tools and MCPs, and a habit of using them to accelerate everything from data exploration to insight generation
* Ability to turn complex analyses into clear business recommendations, with excellent written and verbal communication for audiences ranging from engineers to executives
* A self-starter mindset: you're comfortable with ambiguity, set your own priorities, and thrive in a fast-moving startup environment

### ***Preferred:***

* Experience in the healthcare industry
* Experience in an interdisciplinary/cross-functional field
* Startup experience

### ***Benefits:***

* A competitive salary
* Stock options/equity
* Fully paid for comprehensive health care (medical, dental, vision)
* Pet Insurance
* Life Insurance & Short / Long Term Disability
* 401k Plan
* Unlimited PTO and sick leave
* Parental Leave
* 100% Remote work
* Additional memberships and perks

It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. The **Senior Security Operations Analyst** is critical to protecting Haleon’s corporate assets and managing its day-to-day operational cyber security defences. It involves detailed analysis to identify threats, quantify vulnerabilities and reduce risk to the company. It requires the timely review of cyber security alerts generated by security devices, assessment of the situation and management of incidents to successful resolution. Lead efforts in developing security awareness training for the broader organization.  

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security or related field.
5 years' experience in cybersecurity, with some experience of responding to significant cyber incidents involving Organized Crime and Nations State threat actors.  

**Preferred Skills and Experience:**

* Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security or related field.
* 3 years experience working in a Cyber Security Operations Center.
* Experience working across international manufacturing.
* Understanding of security controls and how they are used to detect and respond
* Knowledge of common network protocols, edge routing technologies, firewall/IDS/IPS, SIEM, EDR/XDR.
* Ability to communicate complex problems succinctly.
* Ability to work within a team environment, sharing workload and responsibility.
CISSP, GCIA, GCDA, GSOC, GCIH.

**Title:** SOC Project Manager

**Location:** (New Carolton, MD or Kearneysville, WV)

**Terms:** Full-time

**Salary:** $160,000 - $210,000 DOE

**Clearance:** Top-Secret

**Travel:** 0% (onsite presence at client facilities as directed)

  

**Position Description**

We are seeking an experienced SOC Project Manager to lead day-to-day Security Operations Center (SOC) operations for a large federal agency. This Key Personnel role manages the SOC function through subordinate leads, directs 24x7x365 incident management operations across multiple sites, and serves as the senior technical lead and primary operational point of contact with the client's SOC leadership. The SOC Project Manager is responsible for the strategic and operational direction of the SOC, ensuring the identification, triage, analysis, response, and recovery from cybersecurity incidents across an enterprise of hundreds of thousands of network connections and endpoints in on-premises and cloud environments.

**The successful candidate will:**

* Serve as the senior technical lead for day-to-day coordination with the client's SOC leadership team.
* Deliver continuous 24x7x365 SOC coverage with no holiday or leave gaps, with sufficient staffing at each site to operate independently in emergencies.
* Meet or exceed performance standards for incident review, escalation, and alarm response times.
* Drive incident handling across all five NIST Cybersecurity Framework functions: Identify, Protect, Detect, Respond, and Recover.
* Maintain COOP readiness and lead SOC operations at alternate sites when COOP is invoked.
* Influence SOC practices and communicate effectively with client executive leadership.
* Continuously improve incident handling processes, procedures, playbooks, and communications based on lessons learned.

**Responsibilities:**

* Manage the strategic and operational direction of SOC incident management and operational coordination through subordinate shift leads and analysts.
* Coordinate day-to-day SOC activities with client SOC leadership, including incident escalations, operational risks, staffing coverage concerns, and service-impacting issues.
* Oversee real-time alert monitoring and triage, incident report intake and coordination, incident analysis, forensic and malware analysis, and containment, eradication, and recovery activities.
* Ensure incident ticket generation, assignment, acknowledgement, notification, escalation, and resolution occur within established timeframes.
* Direct coordination of incident reporting to oversight organizations, CISA, and other external partners on behalf of the client.
* Build and manage shift schedules, on-call rosters, and staffing across multiple sites to ensure 24x7x365 coverage and reliable on-call reachability.
* Ensure SOC personnel complete required training, access procedures, certifications, and on-the-job skills evaluations before receiving privileged access.
* Review and approve incident analysis and forensic findings reports.
* Develop and maintain COOP plans and procedures; participate in COOP exercises, contingency and disaster recovery tests, training, and exercises; and lead SOC operations at the alternate site when invoked.
* Maintain and update SOC operating procedures, incident handling documentation, escalation procedures, contact lists, and knowledge content.
* Coordinate SOC operations with threat intelligence, threat hunting, and SOC engineering teams to translate incident findings into detection and process improvements.
* Provide recurring operational status updates, ticket trends, significant risks, and planned near-term activities to client SOC leadership and the Program Manager.
* Support classified-space alarm response requirements as assigned.
* Identify recurring operational issues and recommend practical improvements to incident handling processes and communications.
* Support surge activation for emerging threats and major incidents.

**Required Skills and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field; three (3) years of additional relevant experience may be substituted in lieu of a degree.
* 10+ years of professional experience.
* Ten (10) years of experience running a SOC, with at least five (5) years running a combined on-premises/cloud SOC.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Wallace Montgomery, a Mid-Atlantic Engineering Firm with a wide variety of clients in the transportation, institutional, and industrial markets, is seeking an experienced, motivated Project Manager across multiple disciplines to provide management of alternative delivery projects. Project Managers are required to provide technical supervision and management of projects assigned to them, and provide input in the preparation of the proposals, budgets, and schedules for new project opportunities. They manage production profitability; implement quality control procedures and liaison with clients. Project Managers may also serve as an Owner’s Representative and lead a team to provide oversight on large-scale alternative delivery projects. It is expected that a Project Manager will work as required to meet the needs of their projects. This may include time outside normally scheduled work hours.

***Essential Functions***: Supervise activities of multiple technical professionals such as engineers/planners/scientists/technicians, project teams and subconsultants.

* Serve as a primary day-to-day owner contact; Lead program delivery within the owner's governance structure and WM's contracted scope; define team responsibilities, decision processes, and reporting
* Guide reviews, permits, procurement support, and construction-phase issues; evaluate changes and obtain decisions through established approval processes.
* Strong communication skills to include coordination with stakeholders and agencies, utilities, design-build teams.
* Maintain integrated schedules, budget forecasts, risk registers, and progress reports; identify issues and recommend corrective action.
* Guide design reviews, permitting, procurement support, and construction-phase coordination. Evaluate changes, provide recommendations, and obtain decisions through established approval processes.
* Participate in presentations such as public meetings and interviews.
* Monitor compliance with scope of work.
* Implement quality control/quality assurance procedures.
* Develop and manage project schedules and budgets. Initiate corrective action as necessary.
* Assist Associates and Partners in financial management duties as requested.
* Perform/monitor project filing and archiving to ensure project records are maintained in accordance with company policies.
* Provide training and guidance to others.
* Monitor current trends/methodologies related to their area of expertise to ensure that the company remains up to date with software, training needs and similar issues.
* Manage projects, including development of project deliverables
* Participation in the procurement of work opportunities.
* Provide service in professional societies and attend meetings.
* Serve as a mentor for young professionals.
* Facilitate coordination across technical disciplines within the firm.
* Promote the firm’s expertise and provide liaison with clients, in a manner to establish and gain confidence and trust.

jobs.title: IT Configuration and Change Business Analyst
jobs.description:
* The Configuration Analyst & Change Coordinator is responsible for supporting the governance, quality, and operational execution of Configuration Management (CMDB) and Change Management processes.
* This role ensures the integrity, accuracy, and compliance of configuration data while coordinating and controlling the lifecycle of IT changes to minimize risk, disruption, and service impact.
* The position plays a critical control function within IT Operations and works closely with infrastructure, application, security, risk, and audit teams.

### **Key Tasks & Responsibilities**

* **Configuration Management Support:**

* Assist in documenting and maintaining configuration items (CIs) in the Configuration Management Database (CMDB).
* Work closely with Configuration Managers to ensure accurate records of hardware, software, and related components.
* Help baseline the current set of CIs and ensure they are properly documented and controlled.
* Track changes to configuration items, ensuring updates are accurately reflected in the CMDB.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to verify and validate CI information, maintaining data integrity.
* Assist Change Managers in assessing the impact of proposed changes on configuration items.
* Provide support in identifying related configuration items affected by change requests.
* Help ensure that changes are properly documented and recorded in the CMDB.
* Assist in verifying and auditing changes to configuration items to ensure accuracy and compliance.
* **Change Management Support:**

* Coordinate the lifecycle of Normal, Standard, and Emergency Changes
* Perform quality checks on change submissions (risk, impact, backout plan, testing evidence)
* Validate risk scoring accuracy based on defined methodology
* Validate completeness before TRB and CAB review
* Maintain the enterprise change calendar
* Identify scheduling conflicts and risk overlaps
* Prepare CAB materials and documentation
* Track Post-Implementation Reviews (PIRs)
* Monitor change success rate and documentation compliance
* Escalate high-risk or non-compliant changes to the Change Manager
* **Continuous Improvement:**

* Participate in continuous assessment of Configuration Management processes and practices.
* Identify areas for improvement and provide input to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of configuration management activities.
* Collaborate with team members to implement approved improvements and changes.
* Stay updated on industry best practices and trends in Configuration Management to contribute to process enhancement efforts.
* Identify opportunities and implement plans to incorporate AI tools and efficiencies.

### **Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field (preferred).
* 2+ Years experience supporting configuration and change management environment, requirements gathering, and documentation.
* Experience with the ITIL processes: configuration, change, release, production migration.
* Knowledge of Change Management principles and practices.
* Knowledge of Configuration Management principles and practices.
* Familiarity with Configuration and Change Management tools and databases, such as ServiceNow.
* Knowledge of IT infrastructure and support.
* Experience developing, writing and implementing SOPs.
* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a team environment.
* Strong experience with Microsoft M365 Suite, PowerBI.
* Hands-on experience with ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow, BMC, Jira Service Management)
* Eagerness to learn and adapt to evolving technologies and processes.
* Excellent coordination and follow-up skills
* Ability to challenge and enforce governance standards diplomatically

jobs.title: Senior Associate, Business Analyst, Enterprise Technology
jobs.description:
**About the Milken Institute**

The Milken Institute is a globally minded, publicly supported, non-partisan, and nonprofit think tank headquartered in Santa Monica, with offices in Washington, DC, New York, London, Abu Dhabi, and Singapore. For the past three decades, the Milken Institute has served as a catalyst for practical, scalable solutions to global challenges by connecting human, financial, and educational resources to those who need them. Guided by a conviction that the best ideas, under-resourced, cannot succeed, we conduct research and analysis and convene top experts, innovators, and influencers from different backgrounds and competing viewpoints. We leverage this expertise and insight to construct programs and policy initiatives. These activities are designed to help people build meaningful lives, in which they can experience health and well-being, pursue effective education and gainful employment, and access the resources required to create ever-expanding opportunities for themselves and their broader communities.

The Milken Institute’s events and programmatic activities, involve the exchange of ideas with leaders from around the world. The Institute hosts more than 200 events each year, with our annual flagship event, Global Conference, bringing together 4,500+ participants from around the world, featuring more than 900+ speakers throughout 200+ sessions over the course of the event.

**About The Position**

The Milken Institute is seeking a highly organized, analytical, and detail-oriented Senior Associate, Business Analyst to join the Project and Portfolio Management Office (PPMO) within the Technology Department. This role reports to the Product Manager, CRM & Data Analytics and supports the delivery, enhancement, and ongoing optimization of enterprise technology solutions, with a primary focus on Salesforce and related data analytics platforms.

The Business Analyst serves as a liaison between business stakeholders and technical teams, translating business needs into clear, actionable requirements and supporting the delivery of technology solutions that align with the Institute's operational objectives.

This is a hands-on role that combines business analysis, project coordination, and Agile delivery support. The Senior Associate will independently coordinate enhancement requests, to serve our operations teams, while supporting larger CRM and data analytics initiatives under the direction of the Product Manager.

Key responsibilities include gathering and documenting business requirements, developing process maps and functional specifications, creating test cases and coordinating user acceptance testing, maintaining Jira boards and facilitating Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning and backlog refinement.

Working closely with the Product Manager, business stakeholders, internal Technology teams, and external vendors, the Business Analyst will help ensure that requirements are clearly defined, work is appropriately tracked, and delivered solutions meet agreed-upon business needs.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, proactive, and analytical, with strong communication, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills. The successful candidate will be comfortable managing multiple assignments, facilitating discussions, translating technical information into accessible language for both technical and non-technical audiences, and following work through to completion.

The Senior Associate will collaborate with colleagues across Business Development, Events, Marketing, Operations, Programming, and other departments throughout the Institute.

**What Success Looks Like**

Success in this role means that smaller technology enhancement requests are managed efficiently from intake through delivery; business requirements are accurately documented and translated into actionable technical specifications; and stakeholders receive clear, timely communication regarding progress, risks, and next steps.

The successful Business Analyst will maintain organized and accurate Jira boards, facilitate effective Agile ceremonies, support sprint execution, and ensure that system enhancements are validated against documented requirements through structured testing and business acceptance.

Over time, the Senior Associate will develop a deeper understanding of the Institute's Salesforce ecosystem, business processes, data structures, and enterprise technology standards. As their skills grow, they will take on increasingly complex enhancements, contribute recommendations for process improvements, and strengthen the efficiency and consistency of CRM and data analytics delivery.

**Responsibilities**

* Business Analysis and Requirements Management: Partner with business stakeholders to gather, analyze, document, and validate business requirements for CRM, data analytics, and related enterprise technology initiatives. Translate business needs into user stories, acceptance criteria, functional specifications, and process maps that can be understood by technical and non-technical audiences.
* Enhancement Request Management: Independently coordinate technology enhancement requests, primarily supporting Business Development and Events. Manage assigned requests from requirements gathering through implementation, testing, and business acceptance, including tracking scope, timelines, dependencies, risks, and stakeholder communications. Escalate changes or issues requiring Product Manager review.
* Agile and Scrum Facilitation: Serve as Scrum Master for assigned initiatives, facilitating sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and other Agile ceremonies. Support the Product Manager in maintaining an organized, prioritized, and actionable product backlog.
* Jira and Project Documentation: Maintain Jira boards, user stories, sprint assignments, task statuses, and delivery documentation. Ensure that requirements, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and progress update

Support full lifecycle development activities, including internal and external integration design, testing, troubleshooting, and implementation.

Evaluate the feasibility and suitability of proposed information technology projects and recommend appropriate solutions.

Testing, Implementation, and Operational Support. Create detailed unit and system test scripts based on functional requirements.

Facilitate user acceptance testing activities and coordinate issue resolution as required.

Support vendor activities and County implementation efforts for the Jail Management System replacement.

Gather and document business requirements for change requests, including break/fix activities. reporting, system performance, and process-control metrics.

Serve as a primary technical resource in a post-production environment and contribute to continuous system and process improvement. 5

Stakeholder Engagement and Customer Support. Confer with customer agencies to provide advice, consultation, and technical assistance during project implementation.

Provide responsive, high-quality customer service to internal and external stakeholders.

Establish and maintain productive working relationships with County personnel, vendors, and technical teams.

Participate in or conduct user training as needed. Identify and pursue innovative initiatives that improve current processes, systems, and service delivery.

Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in Business, Computer Science, or a related field.

At least five years of experience in systems analysis, change management analysis, project management, program analysis, or a closely related discipline.

Demonstrated experience supporting public safety implementations.

Demonstrated experience serving as a primary technical resource in a post-production environment.

jobs.title: Sr. Technical Program Manager, Networking Operational Excellence
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

We are looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to join the AWS Networking Operational Excellence team.  
  
The ideal candidate will require proven technical project management, critical thinking and problem solving skills. The candidate should be open to new challenges, extremely good at multi-tasking, innovative, self-directed and a great team player.
  
  
Candidates should drive continuous process improvement, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional operational and software engineering teams to solve problems and implement new solutions.  
  
You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards deliverables for network operations. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  
  
If you like to work with new technologies and optimize existing technology, and have experience participating in network/systems support for a large-scale enterprise or a service provider, we encourage you to apply! Your work will play a key role in driving the stability and sustainability of next-generation networking solutions.
  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* You’ll drive both network hardware and software programs to meet the ever-growing customer demand.
* You’ll manage competing cross-organizational projects/programs on a global scale.
* You’ll interact cross-team Network Managers, cross-team Technical Program Managers, Engineers, and Data Center Technicians and senior management.
* You will run meetings, create and maintain timelines, and keep large, diverse groups informed of progress and obstacles.
* You’ll work with engineers to develop detailed and creative solutions to complex problems, while keeping a watchful-eye on timelines and costs.
* You’ll drive simplification efforts in engineering and project/program management, and architectures to unblock innovation.
* You’ll partner with multiple teams across various locations to ensure priorities are agreed and outcomes are delivered.

  
A day in the life  
Technical Program Managers in the BERE organization have a wide range of responsibilities: we work with internal partners to develop and implement the next gen infrastructures along with the tooling ecosystems to support with these platforms driving efficiency and scalability through the automation of builds, configuration deployment, and the scaling of capacity. As our network is one of the largest in the world, there is no blue print at our scale allowing our engineers to develop solutions to the complex challenges that we face daily. We encourage durable solutions that look around corners while taking into consideration our customer needs from a cost, performance, and reliability perspective. Our team develops tooling that provides the required visibility and control of traffic across the network, while prioritizing the automatic mitigation of events to minimize the impact to our customers during events.  
  
About the team  
Within AWS Networking, the Backbone, Enterprise, and Regional Engineering (BERE) organization is responsible for the design, implementation, and operations of a wide array of networking infrastructure that provide global connectivity between all AWS Regions and edge locations. We provide the massive scale required to support our AWS customers and internal services, via a network that grows by 70% annually. In addition, we have teams that are responsible for the design and operation of our global corporate office and data center network, allowing tens of thousands of Amazonians to perform their daily tasks in support of our customers. We provide software tooling that allows the global AWS footprint to scale via new Region and edge location builds, automated systems that control the flow of traffic across devices, and are building our next generation network controllers to drive improved performance and efficiency across the networks that we operate.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* 3+ years of software development experience
* 5+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership

jobs.title: Operations Research Analyst
jobs.description:
**Position Summary:**

HunaTek is seeking a highly skilled and motivated Operations Research Analyst to join our dynamic team in the defense sector. The ideal candidate will possess a strong background in decision support techniques, data collection, analytics, and reporting, with a focus on meeting client requirements. As an Operations Research Analyst, you will be responsible for analyzing datasets provided by Department of Defense (DoD) customers, identifying trends and anomalies, and utilizing this information for forecasting purposes.

If you are passionate about leveraging data to support critical decision-making in the defense market and possess the necessary skills and qualifications, we invite you to apply for this exciting opportunity. Join us in making a meaningful impact on the future of defense operations and strategic planning.

**Essential Job Functions:**

* Decision Support Analysis:
  + Support and/or lead Business Case Analysis (BCA) and Economic Analysis (EA) studies.
  + Lead stakeholder engagement and study scoping efforts.
  + Lead, develop, update, and apply mathematical and logical methodologies for estimating program benefits, costs, and risks.
  + Lead, develop, update, manipulate, and maintain cost and affordability models.
  + Lead efforts in collecting, normalizing, and analyzing complex data.
  + Evaluate program investment and acquisition strategies and courses of action.
  + Conduct planning for acquisition of capabilities.
* Data Collection and Analysis:
  + Collect, process, and analyze complex datasets provided by DoD customers to extract meaningful insights.
  + Utilize statistical methods, modeling techniques, and optimization algorithms to identify trends, patterns, and anomalies.
* Client Interfacing:
  + Work closely with clients to understand their operational needs and requirements.
  + Develop tailored analytics and reporting solutions to meet specific client demands and enhance decision-making processes.
* Forecasting:
  + Utilize advanced forecasting models to predict future trends and outcomes based on historical data and current inputs.
  + Provide accurate and timely forecasts to assist clients in strategic planning and resource allocations.
* Department of Defense Knowledge: Possess a strong knowledge base in Department of Defense operations, policies, and procedures.
  + Stay informed about the latest developments and changes within the DoD to ensure analyses align with current defense priorities.
* DoD Acquisition Programs:
  + Demonstrate experience and familiarity with DoD Acquisition programs and processes.
  + Apply expertise to assess and optimize acquisition strategies, resource allocation, and program management.
* Support on-site delivery in the Quantico and Stafford areas.

**Skills and Qualification Required:**

* US Citizenship required.
* Active Secret Security Clearance or ability to obtain a Secret Security Clearance.
* Problem Solving and Analytical Skills - Ability to identify problems, analyze data, and develop effective solutions.
* Mathematical & Statistical Knowledge - Proficiency in data analysis tools and techniques such as Python, R, or similar languages.
* Communication Skills - Strong communication skills with the ability to convey complex analytical results to non-technical stakeholders.
* Collaborative mindset with the ability to work effectively in a team-oriented environment.

**Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor's or advanced degree in Operations Research, Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, or a related field.
* Proven experience in data analysis, statistical modeling, and forecasting, with a focus on defense-related datasets.
* Experience supporting BCAs, AoAs, EA or other analytical studies.
* Previous work experience in the defense sector, particularly with DoD Acquisition programs.
* Experience with data visualization tools and techniques to effectively communicate findings.

**About Us:**

At HunaTek, we build teams of people from all backgrounds with varying levels of experience, knowing firsthand that diversity of thought will strengthen our ability to deliver for our customers. We work hand in hand with Federal civilian and military staff, pulling together to further the interests of our nation and home and abroad.

Whenever possible, we provide opportunities for our employees to learn new skills, obtain certifications, attend industry events, and have some fun together.

**Our Benefits:**

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to make sure our employees and their families have access to good health care, are insured against catastrophic health events, can put money aside for retirement and are able to maintain a healthy work-life balance. These benefits include:

* Comprehensive medical, dental and vision
* Long-term and short-term disability insurance and term life insurance
* 401(K) with safe harbor contribution
* Paid time off and 11 paid holidays
* Tuition and career development assistance
* A selection of voluntary benefits

This job description will be reviewed periodically as duties and responsibilities change with business necessity. Essential and marginal job functions are subject to modification.

Equal opportunity employer as to all protected groups, including protected veterans and individuals with disabilities.
