jobs.description:
Overview:

Apogee has an exciting new opportunity for a **Reports & Data Analyst** **to** provide support for the Executive Airlift Communications Network (EACN) support task order, which provides Command, Control, Communications (C3) services for multiple critical U.S. Government missions via multiple Air to Global Information Grid (GIG) Gateways (A2G2’s) supported by a Systems Integration Lab (SIL).

The Reports & Data Analyst will transform complex, multi-source network and security data into actionable insight that drives effective and practical IT resolution decisions. This role requires conducting full lifecycle analysis of IT trends (e.g., SLC3S-A systems) across a variety of network databases, developing robust analytics and reporting capabilities, and supporting the Government Security Operations Center (GSOC) with real-time incident monitoring, analysis, and after-action reporting to senior leadership. The ideal candidate thrives in a mission-critical, 24/7-sensitive environment and can rapidly translate data into decisions that protect critical C3 systems supporting senior U.S. Government leaders.

This is a full-time position located on-site at Joint Base Andrews (JBA) in Andrews, MD.

**\*\*\* This position is contingent upon contract award.\*\*\***

  
Responsibilities:

* Interpret data into information, information into insight, and insight into effective and practical IT resolution decisions, including full lifecycle analysis of IT trends (e.g., SLC3S-A systems) based on a variety of network databases.
* Develop analysis and reporting capabilities to support mission operations and decision-making.
* Interpret data, analyze results using statistical techniques, and provide ongoing reports to stakeholders and leadership.
* Develop and implement databases, data collection systems, data analytics, and other strategies that optimize statistical efficiency and quality.
* Identify, analyze, and interpret trends or patterns in complex data sets.
* Monitor, analyze, detect, and respond to incidents and activities identified by the GSOC.
* Collect information and data to identify, analyze, and report events and incidents to the GSOC that may impact SLC3S-A systems.
* Respond within 15 minutes to any crisis or urgent situation occurring during duty hours, supporting mitigation of immediate and potential threats.
* Perform data collection and cyber analysis to execute a wide variety of tasks supporting response, mitigation, and after-action reporting to senior leaders.
* Provide analytical support as needed for projects and systems to ensure effective operations of cyber capabilities.

Qualifications:

**Minimum** **Experience:**

**Citizenship:** Must be a US citizen  
**Clearance:** Must have and be able to maintain a TS/SCI level clearance

**Education:** Bachelor's Degree  
**Years of Experience:** Twelve (12) years of experience in the respective technical/professional discipline; to include five (5) years of DoD experience

**Preferred Qualifications:**

**Education:** Master's Degree  
**Years of Experience:** Three (3) years of experience in data analysis, reporting, IT Systems Analysis, or a related technical discipline, preferably within a DoD or Federal Governement environment.

**Technical Experience:**

* Demonstrated experience interpreting data sets and translating findings into clear, actionable reports for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Experience with statistical analysis techniques and tools (e.g., Excel, SQL, Python, R, or similar) to identify trends and patterns in large/complex data sets.
* Experience developing, maintaining, or working within databases and data collection systems.
* Experience monitoring, triaging, and reporting on security or network incidents within a Security Operations Center (SOC)/GSOC or similar 24/7 operational environment.
* Familiarity with network architectures, IT infrastructure, and systems trend analysis (e.g., SLC3S-A or comparable C3/network systems).
* Ability to respond rapidly (within 15 minutes) to crisis/urgent situations and support incident mitigation efforts.

**Additional Information:**  
**Location:** Joint Base Andrews (JBA) in Andrews, MD  
**On-site:** Full-time on-site position  
**Travel:** 10% travel may be required

**\*\*\* This position is contingent upon contract award.\*\*\***

jobs.title: Medical Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Medical Data Analyst for DHO, CSSD shall provide health care support for the Directorate of Healthcare Operations at A.T. Augusta Military Medical Center (ATAMMC), Fort Belvoir, VA. The contractor will work in conjunction with other health care providers, professionals, and non- contract personnel.
  
  
**Mandatory knowledge and skills:**  

* Proficiency in Structured Query Language (SQL), Microsoft SQL Server, and Microsoft Access.
* Proficiency in Visual Basic for Applications (VBA).
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.

**Degree/Education/Certification:**  

* An undergraduate degree in a technical field such as business, management Information systems, data analytics.

Experience
  
  

* Experience in business data analysis and process improvement projects.
* Experience in clinical data analysis.
* Exceptional skills in customer service.
* Exceptional skills in oral, visual, and written communications.
* Exceptional skills in time management.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively.

**Specific Duties/Tasks The Contractor Shall Perform:**  

* Coordinates and provides consultation on multiple projects, studies, and systems analyses associated with health care programs and systems.
* Conducts both quantitative and qualitative analyses in support of clinical and business workflow processes and recommends the planning for corrective courses of actions.
* Communicates with clinics to diagnose business problems, develops, and presents appropriate sets of tools and applications as a solution, and provides training to clients.
* Supports the Chief and Deputy of Clinical Systems Support Department in terms of technical and administrative task requirements on a daily basis with strict adherence to suspense dates, information accuracy, and professional quality of work.
* Utilizes MHS GENESIS, FMIS, Health Analytics, M2 and other data sources to gather clinical operational data and prepare it for review by the Chief and Deputy as requested.
* Manages provider templates, schedules, and appointments in the outpatient clinics utilizing MHS GENESIS.
* Creates and maintains various databases in order to store operational data and update various tools, reports, and dashboards on a continual basis.
* Uses SQL and other data query tools to proficiently query, transform, and extract required information in order to prepare reports and presentations with both quantitative and qualitative analyses as well as recommendations.
* Implements VBA programming with clear and organized code documentation as well as comments to automate processes that support departmental mission of work and increase business efficiency.
* Presents information derived from data and process analyses to various clients with proficiency in oral, visual, and written communications.
* Completes all assigned actions and tasks within suspense period.
* Reports to the department Chief, Deputy, and appropriate team leads of work progress, task status, and key findings on a daily basis.
* Communicates with internal and external customers and visitors to the office.
* Maintains and submits records of payroll timecards and Defense Medical Human Resources System- internet (Dhesi) in a timely and accurate manner.

**Work Environment/Physical Requirements:** The work is primarily sedentary.
  
  

* However, there may be some physical demands. Requirements include prolonged walking, standing, sitting, or bending. Use of one or more computer programs and monitors may be required daily.

**Unique Military Health Care Systems/Procedures:**  

* MHS GENESIS
* FMIS
* Health Analytics
* M2

**Salary Range:** $72,500–$80,000 annually. Actual compensation will be determined based on the candidate's experience, qualifications, skills, and other job-related factors. In addition to base salary, we offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes health insurance, paid time off, and retirement benefits.
  
  
If you do not find interest in this opportunity but know of someone who may, we kindly ask that you refer the individual to RWD Consulting, LLC by forwarding this job posting.
  
  
Established in 2004, RWD Consulting, LLC (RWD) provides tomorrow’s solutions today. We achieve mission-critical results for federal, public and private sectors through our core competencies: Data Management & Analytics, Information Technology, Logistics & Supply Chain Management, Facility Operations & Management, and Project Management, Administrative & Technical Support. Our services enhance our clients’ capabilities and allow them to focus on their mission and goals.
  
  
RWD Consulting, LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
The Business Analyst is responsible for leading discovery, facilitation, and requirements development for both technical and non-technical initiatives across the organization. This role partners with stakeholders across departments and business units to identify problems, analyze complex needs, and translate them into clear, actionable requirements that support effective solutions.

The Business Analyst serves as a trusted facilitator and thought partner, supporting alignment and informed decision-making among diverse stakeholder groups. This position requires an experienced analyst who can operate independently, navigate ambiguity, and apply proven business analysis practices. This role helps define the problem space rather than simply documenting proposed solutions and brings clarity in situations where requirements are incomplete, conflicting, or evolving.

**Note: This position is considered Hybrid and will need to commute to ACOG's office located in Washington, D.C.**

#### **Supervisory Responsibilities:**

* This position has no direct supervisory responsibilities but does serve as a coach and mentor for other positions in the department.

#### **Duties/Responsibilities:**

* Lead discovery sessions and stakeholder discussions to define business problems, desired outcomes, success measures, requirements, and assumptions.
* Analyze and document current and future-state processes, workflows, business rules, and system interactions; identify opportunities to reduce complexity, duplication, and manual work.
* Review incoming requests, clarify the business need and impact, identify affected owners and teams, prepare intake summaries, and route requests for evaluation and prioritization. Identify recurring themes and intake bottlenecks to support broader improvements.
* Develop clear, concise, and testable requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria for technical and non-technical initiatives, tailoring the analysis approach to the needs and complexity of the work.
* Identify risks, gaps, and dependencies across projects, business processes, applications, digital platforms, data, integrations, vendors, and support teams; engage appropriate subject-matter experts and delivery partners.
* Participate in solution design, backlog refinement, and sprint planning to clarify requirements and maintain alignment on decisions, dependencies, and expected outcomes.
* Partner with QA and business stakeholders to support testing, user acceptance, and implementation readiness, including changes to workflows, roles, documentation, training, support, and ongoing ownership.
* Perform other duties as assigned to support organizational priorities and strategic initiatives.

#### **Required Skills/Abilities:**

* Advanced business analysis skills, including requirements elicitation, analysis, documentation, and validation.
* Exceptional facilitation skills with the ability to lead productive discussions among diverse, cross-functional stakeholder groups.
* Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills with the ability to decompose complex problems and synthesize information across teams and departments.
* Ability to gather and organize information about business impact, urgency, risk, dependencies, and expected value to support intake and prioritization decisions.
* Ability to recognize when a request may involve applications, integrations, data, security, infrastructure, digital platforms, or vendor dependencies and engage the appropriate subject-matter experts.
* Proficiency in writing high-quality user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional requirements for technical and non-technical audiences.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey complex concepts clearly and concisely.
* Ability to operate independently, manage ambiguity, and drive outcomes without close supervision.

#### **Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree required in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field.
* Minimum of 5 years of professional experience performing business analysis in complex organizational environments.
* Demonstrated experience leading requirements and facilitation efforts for cross-functional, multi-department initiatives.
* Proven track record of delivering high-quality requirements and user stories that support successful solution delivery.
* Experience working within Agile delivery frameworks, including Scrum, and supporting analysis practices such as intake process, requirements triage, backlog refinement and user story development.
* Experience using tools such as Wrike, Jira, Azure DevOps, Lucidchart, Miro, Visio, or similar platforms for intake, requirements management, backlog support and process modeling.
* Experience working on both technology-focused and business-focused projects.
* Experience within membership associations or similar organizations is helpful but not required.
* Strong understanding of organizational operations, change impacts, and stakeholder management.

**Our Perks**

Paid Parental Leave – Breastfeeding Friendly Workplace – Flexible work schedule – Commuting Allowance – Generous Paid Time Off – Holiday Pay – Life Insurance – Community Volunteering Opportunities – Generous 401(k) Company Contributions – Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance – Learning Opportunities and Tuition Reimbursement – Company-Sponsored Team Outings – and more!

With a particular focus on fraud, digital risk and brand protection, you’ll help provide the intelligence that supports informed decisions and proactive defence.

You’ll monitor cyber threats, fraud trends, impersonation activity, account takeover risks and wider digital abuse affecting easyJet customers and brand. You’ll help triage, investigate and escalate emerging threats when action is needed.

jobs.title: CRM & Revenue Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
**About the Role**

We're looking for a curious, commercially sharp CRM & Revenue Operations Analyst to join our growing RevOps function. This is a dual-natured role: on one side, hands-on CRM administration and data stewardship within a collaborative team; on the other, a broader remit that spans the full commercial journey — from Marketing through Sales to Customer Success — ensuring the processes, tools, and data that connect them are coherent, reliable, and built to support business growth.

You'll work closely with our Revenue Operations Manager, based in Copenhagen, and collaborate with market teams, sales and marketing stakeholders, and internal IT across all 14 markets. This isn't a role for someone who wants to execute instructions in isolation. We want someone who understands the commercial context behind what they're building — and who takes ownership of making sure it actually works for the people using it.

**What You'll Do**

**CRM Administration & Development**

– Support the maintenance and ongoing development of our HubSpot CRM in collaboration with the RevOps team — covering data quality, property management, workflow logic, and pipeline integrity across all markets

– Assist in building, testing, and documenting automation workflows, lifecycle stages, and custom data structures

– Act as a reliable point of contact for CRM-related queries from market teams, escalating where needed and closing the loop on issues

**Reporting & Market Intelligence**

– Build and maintain dashboards and reports in HubSpot to support sales leadership and country managers across all 14 markets

– Translate reporting requests into structured, actionable outputs — not just visualisations, but insights that inform decisions

– Monitor data health proactively and flag inconsistencies before they compound

**Revenue Operations — Marketing to Customer Success**

– Support the design, documentation, and continuous improvement of processes that span the full commercial funnel — from marketing acquisition through sales pipeline management to customer success handoffs

– Help ensure that tools, data flows, and operational logic work coherently across functions, reducing friction and improving visibility at every stage

– Contribute to ICP qualification frameworks, segmentation models, lead management logic, and pipeline hygiene practices

– Collaborate with internal IT to support integrations between internal systems and the broader commercial toolstack, helping bridge technical and business requirements

**Stakeholder Management & Cross-functional Collaboration**

– Work alongside sales, marketing, customer success, and IT stakeholders to understand needs, gather requirements, and translate them into operational solutions

– Communicate clearly across functions and markets — managing expectations, flagging dependencies, and keeping the right people informed

– Represent the RevOps function as a reliable, solutions-oriented partner rather than a bottleneck

**Training Materials & Process Documentation**

– Develop clear, structured training materials covering tools, processes, and operational frameworks — ensuring teams across all markets have what they need to work effectively

– Maintain process and system documentation as a living resource, updated as workflows evolve

– Work across our training infrastructure (including Supered and Sana) to publish and distribute materials to the right audiences

– Identify knowledge gaps through stakeholder engagement and translate them into practical, usable guidance

**What We're Looking For**

– 1–2 years of experience in revenue operations, sales operations, marketing operations, CRM administration, or a closely adjacent role

– Solid working knowledge of CRM systems — HubSpot experience is a significant advantage and will be strongly prioritised

– Analytically capable, with the ability to turn raw data into clear, usable business insights

– Sharp commercial instinct — you understand how operational decisions connect to revenue outcomes across Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success

– Comfortable working cross-functionally, including with technical stakeholders such as IT, and translating between business needs and system capabilities

– Detail-oriented and process-driven, without losing sight of the bigger picture

– Excellent written and spoken English; additional languages are a genuine bonus — Danish, Swedish, Norwegian, German, French, Dutch, Portuguese, or Polish

– Proactively curious — you ask questions before you build, and you build things that last

**Nice to Have**

– Hands-on HubSpot experience beyond basic CRM use — workflows, reporting, custom properties, or integrations

– Familiarity with sales intelligence tools such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator or Evergrowth

– Experience supporting tool integrations or working alongside IT on system connectivity

– Exposure to multi-market or international business environments

– A track record of creating structured training content or process documentation

– Background in B2B services, IT staffing, or professional consultancy

**What We Offer**

– A central role in emagine's revenue infrastructure, with genuine cross-market scope from day one

– Direct mentorship from an experienced Revenue Operations Manager with deep HubSpot and systems expertise

– Broad exposure to a modern RevOps toolstack and clear room to grow — technically and strategically

– A hybrid working setup with real autonomy and flexibility, based in one of our office locations across our 14 markets

– The opportunity to grow alongside a function that is actively expanding its influence across the business

**We empower companies with high-end IT services**

jobs.title: AI Market and Competitive Intelligence Analyst
jobs.description:
Job ID

26WD101765

**Job Requisition ID #**

26WD101765

Autodesk is shaping the future of the design and make industries by helping our customers navigate a rapidly evolving AI-driven landscape. Supporting our Autodesk AI initiatives, you will help us understand how AI and new business models are reshaping the competitive landscape across Manufacturing, AECO (Architecture, Engineering, Construction, and Operations), and Media and Entertainment.

  
  

This is an individual contributor role on a team with deep business, industry, and technical experience. A successful candidate builds with AI by default, not as a tool added on top.

  
  

The way competitive intelligence gets done is changing faster than most business functions can adapt. We’re hiring for that gap. You will spend as much time building the systems that produce our intelligence as you will producing it.

  
  

**Responsibilities**

* Build and maintain the automated systems that produce our intelligence, including source monitoring and refresh cadences
* Find the parts of our process that shouldn’t be manual anymore and fix them without waiting for permission
* Track how AI is changing our markets, following competitors, startups, funding, product releases, partnerships, research, talent movement, and regulatory shifts
* Work directly with business functions, product management, engineering, and technical benchmarking to define target markets, map competitive landscapes, size opportunities, identify gaps, and test market and commercial assumptions against what is actually buildable
* Synthesize qualitative and quantitative information into clear points of view, challenging assumptions, reconciling conflicting perspectives, and connecting findings to broader implications for Autodesk
* You have a working sense of what is hard and what is easy to build with AI right now, and you can form a reasonable hypothesis about how a competitor pulled something off
* Take the lead on coordinating research and intelligence projects as needed, bringing structure to ambiguous questions, facilitating discussions, managing contributors and timelines, keeping teams on track, and ensuring conclusions are captured in clear final deliverables
* Produce recurring competitive intelligence and fast-turn analysis for leaders, translating complex market and technical developments into concise, executive-ready briefs, presentations, and market maps, including for C-suite
* Keep the competitive picture available to teams on demand
* Bring us tools, methods, and ideas before we know to ask. Push when you think we’re doing something the slow way
* Occasional travel to industry events and internal meetings
  

  

**Minimum Qualifications**

* You’ve built workflows, agents, or pipelines that run without you. Bring one to the interview and walk us through the choices you made
* Strong analytical judgment and the ability to turn incomplete or fragmented information into a defensible point of view
* You start things. The work you’re proudest of is probably something nobody assigned you
* 5+ years of experience in one or more of the following, or a combination: competitive intelligence, market research, business intelligence, strategy, consulting, product management, software or data engineering
* Know where automated output needs a human check, and build that check into the system
* Ability to lead projects or significant workstreams involving multiple stakeholders and deadlines
* Data storytelling and presentation skills, with the ability to make complex information clear to senior stakeholders
* Ability to collaborate on analytical work, including contributing to projects led by others and bringing different perspectives into a coherent output
* Bachelor’s degree in business, economics, data science, computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Demonstrated interest in physical AI across Autodesk industries: Manufacturing, AECO, or Media and Entertainment
* You can read a competitor’s model release or data position and say what it means for their roadmap and their cost structure
* Experience with customer discovery, market validation, go-to-market analysis, or business case development
* Experience with Python, SQL, or similar, at the level of getting something working rather than shipping production code
* Familiarity with incumbent market data sources such as PitchBook, CB Insights, Crunchbase, or similar platforms
* Experience with Excel, Power BI, Tableau, or similar analytical tools
* MBA or equivalent business experience

**Learn More**

**About Autodesk**

Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.

We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.

When you’re an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us!

Salary is one part of Autodesk’s competitive compensation package. Offers are based on the candidate’s experience and geographic location. jobs.title: Principal Business Analyst
jobs.description:
Indra is a leading global technology and consulting company, and a trusted technological partner for the core business operations of its clients worldwide. It stands at the forefront of key sectors including Transport, Defence, Air Traffic Management and Space, alongside advanced Information Technology services delivered through Minsait, and cutting-edge capabilities in Sovereign AI, Cybersecurity, and Cyberdefence via IndraMind.

The company's business model is built around a comprehensive portfolio of proprietary products, combining strong innovation with a high-value focus for customers.

With more than 2,500 projects implemented across 50 countries and over 100 cities, Indra is a global benchmark in innovative transportation and mobility solutions. It is recognised as one of the world's top three companies in public transportation management systems. Indra's technology supports the daily journeys of over 78 million people, helping to reduce more than 10 million tonnes of CO₂ emissions annually, and helping save nearly 3,000 lives through improved traffic management and road safety.

Indra Group is paving the way to a more secure and better-connected future through innovative solutions, trusted relationships and the very best talent. Sustainability sits at the heart of its strategy and culture, driving efforts to address current and future social and environmental challenges.

In the 2024 financial year, Indra achieved revenues of €5.5 billion, over 60,000 professionals, maintained a local presence in 46 countries, and operated across more than 140 countries worldwide.

As the technological partner for its customers' key operations, Indra is at the core of their business, and Indra's four values guide everything we do:

**Innovation** - Our capacity for innovation, cutting-edge solutions, and specialised team of professionals enables us to drive a safer, more connected future through technology.

**Trust** - We work with strength, commitment, and reliability, delivering quality solutions to build trust with customers, employees, partners, investors, and society.

**Connection** - We harness the power of collaboration, connect ideas and solutions, and adapt to our customers' needs, supporting them on the path to a better future.

**Foresight** - We anticipate future needs to make the world safer and more connected, transforming our experience and knowledge into solutions for a better tomorrow.

**Overview****Role Purpose:**

* Lead the discovery, requirements definition, target operating model design and business case development for a standardised, ITIL-aligned Asset Management capability.
* Connect hardware and software asset management, lifecycle management, spares and logistics, security, finance, contracts, data and tooling into a coherent managed service capability.

**Key Objectives**

What the Role Will Achieve:

* Establish an evidence-based view of current processes, tools, data, reporting, ownership and customer obligations.
* Define end-to-end requirements from plan and procure through operate, replace, retire and dispose.
* Align stakeholders on the target operating model, governance, service boundaries and accountabilities.
* Create a prioritised, traceable requirements catalogue and an investable business case.
* Define the tooling, integration, pilot and rollout direction.

Core Scope:

* Hardware and Software Asset Management.
* Lifecycle, end-of-life and end-of-support governance.
* Spares, depots, logistics, asset movement and chain of custody.
* Contract, licence, security, audit and financial governance.
* ServiceNow, discovery, repositories, barcode, warehouse and licence tooling.

Key Responsibilities

Analysis and Engagement Leadership

* Own the BA approach, plan, standards, scope and requirements governance.
* Lead workshops across Managed Services, Field Services, Contracts, Finance, Procurement, Security, Service Design and Tooling.
* Resolve conflicting needs and escalate material decisions, risks and dependencies.
* Provide direction and quality assurance to the supporting BA.

Design and Business Case

* Lead current-state, gap, pain-point, risk and duplication analysis.
* Develop the operating model, process architecture, governance, RACI, service catalogue and reporting framework.
* Assess tooling and integration options against agreed requirements.
* Develop costs, benefits, risks, funding profile, phasing, pilot scope and roadmap.

Key Deliverables

* Current-state assessment and process maps.
* Requirements catalogue and traceability.
* Target operating model.
* Governance and RACI.
* Future-state process architecture.
* Service catalogue and customer reporting framework.
* Tooling and integration assessment.
* Business case.
* Pilot definition.
* Implementation roadmap.

 **Requirements**  
  
Essential

* Extensive experience leading complex BA or enterprise transformation engagements.
* Strong requirements engineering, process modelling, facilitation and operating model design skills.
* Ability to work across operational, commercial, financial, security, data and technology stakeholders.
* Experience shaping business cases and leading other analysts.
* Excellent executive communication, negotiation and decision facilitation.

Desirable

* ITIL, IT service management or managed services experience.
* Hardware, Software or IT Asset Management experience.
* Knowledge of ServiceNow, CMDB, discovery or licence management tooling.
* Understanding of lifecycle, spares, logistics, audit, compliance and secure disposal.
* Experience in complex customer and supplier environments.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
**JOB PURPOSE:**

The Project Manager is responsible for overseeing the execution of complex power and automation projects from order confirmation to final delivery. This role handles high-value contracts, intricate technical configurations, and cross-functional coordination to ensure successful project on-time delivery, customer satisfaction, and profitability.

**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES:**

* **Project Planning & Execution:**

  + Lead the end-to-end execution of Switchgear & RTU projects with high BOM complexity and strategic importance.
  + Develop detailed project plans, timelines, and resource allocations.
  + Monitor project progress, manage risks, and implement corrective actions as needed.
* **Customer & Stakeholder Management:**

  + Serve as the primary point of contact for key customers and internal stakeholders.
  + Conduct regular project reviews and status updates with clients.
  + Responsible for achieving each customer’s monthly targeted SIOP.
  + Follow up with customers for on time payment settlement/ issuance of LC on time/ issuance of PDC on time as per monthly target set.
  + Ensure alignment between customer expectations and internal capabilities
  + Manage the internal project team and work across functions to drive smooth and successful project delivery
* **Technical & Commercial Oversight:**

  + Responsible for the FAT of each customer’s order which requires inspection. Coordinate, arrange FAT and close out any comments from FAT to have a successful Dispatch Clearance.
  + Review and validate high-value quotations and technical specifications.
  + Coordinate with engineering, procurement, external suppliers and production teams to ensure feasibility and compliance.
  + Manage change orders, scope adjustments, and commercial negotiations.
* **Cross-functional Coordination:**

  + Collaborate with sales, order handling, logistics, and finance teams to ensure seamless execution.
  + Facilitate meetings to align on project milestones and deliverables including internal departments, customers, suppliers and sub-contractors.
  + Ensure timely documentation, invoicing, and project closure.
  + Serve as the technical liaison for Switchgear / Automation projects in the MV sector.
  + Collaborate with the stakeholders to ensure smooth integration and deployment of solutions.
  + Review and validate technical configurations for Power projects in coordination with engineering.
  + Assist in BOM cost optimization related to switchgear components and subsystems.
  + Provide pre-sales technical guidance and product demonstrations where scope is included.
  + Participate in customer training and seminars on switchgear solutions as needed.
* **Reporting & Documentation:**

  + Maintain accurate project records, including schedules, budgets, and communications.
  + Provide regular reports on project status, risks, and financial performance.
  + Support audits and post-project reviews.
  + High Customer Satisfaction

**JOB CONTEXT:**

The Project Manager is effective in leading and managing projects from awarding of order, through implementation, testing and delivery. Ensuring customer project kick-off is completed within the agreed standard time frame from sales handover to initiation and project is completed within the time frame, with the requested quality and within the approved budgeted costs.

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical engineering, Project Management, or related field.
* Candidate experienced in customer coordination, previously dealt with UAE Utilities would be added advantage.
* Require excellent communication skills in English; Arabic speaking would be an advantage.
* Candidate must have valid UAE driving license and preferably own car.
* Candidate will handle sub-contractor coordination as required and necessary.

**Minimum Experience:**

* Five to Ten years of experience in Project Management, preferably in electrical distribution or industrial equipment.

**Job-Specific Skills:**

* Strong understanding of power and automation systems, electrical distribution networks, and BOM structures.
* Proficiency in project management tools (e.g., MS Project, Primavera) and ERP systems (e.g., SAP).
* PMP or equivalent certification is a plus.

**Behavioural** **Competencies:**

* Strong leadership and decision-making skills
* Excellent communication, Interpersonal, negotiation and presentation skills
* High attention to detail and organizational skills
* Ability to manage multiple complex projects simultaneously
* Customer-centric and results-driven mindset

jobs.title: Arada | Senior Project Manager - Development
jobs.description:
**About us**

At Arada, we create communities that inspire healthier, happier and more meaningful lives. Through innovative developments, exceptional customer experiences and a commitment to sustainability, we are shaping places where people can live, work and thrive.

Joining Arada means becoming part of a collaborative, ambitious and forward-thinking team dedicated to delivering excellence across every aspect of our business.

**Role Purpose:**

The Senior Project Manager will lead the end-to-end execution of development projects from design development through procurement, construction, handover, and close-out. Working closely with internal stakeholders, consultants, contractors, and authorities, the successful candidate will ensure the successful delivery of projects aligned with ARADA's strategic objectives, quality expectations, and commercial goals.

**Key Responsibilities:**

Project Leadership

* Lead the planning, execution, monitoring, and successful delivery of assigned development projects.
* Manage projects through all development phases including design, authority approvals, procurement, construction, testing & commissioning, handover, and defects liability period.
* Develop and maintain detailed project execution plans, schedules, budgets, and risk registers.
* Monitor project performance against agreed milestones and implement corrective actions where required.

Design & Development Management

* Coordinate with the Design Management team to ensure designs meet project objectives, regulatory requirements, cost targets, and construction feasibility.
* Review consultant deliverables to ensure quality, completeness, and alignment with project briefs.
* Drive value engineering initiatives while maintaining design intent and customer experience.

Construction Management

* Oversee contractors, consultants, and project management consultants throughout project execution.
* Monitor construction progress, quality, health & safety, and compliance with project specifications.
* Conduct regular site inspections and progress meetings to ensure timely issue resolution.
* Ensure projects achieve practical completion and handover in accordance with company standards.

Commercial & Financial Management

* Work closely with Commercial and Procurement teams to monitor project budgets and cost performance.
* Review variation orders, claims, payment applications, and commercial risks.
* Support contract administration and ensure contractual obligations are fulfilled.

Stakeholder Management

* Act as the primary point of contact for internal stakeholders across Development, Design, Commercial, Finance, Legal, Sales, Marketing, Customer Experience, and Facilities Management.
* Coordinate with government authorities and utility providers to obtain required approvals and permits.
* Build strong relationships with consultants, contractors, and external partners.

Risk & Governance

* Identify project risks and develop mitigation strategies.
* Ensure compliance with company governance, development processes, quality standards, and HSE requirements.
* Prepare executive reports and project updates for senior management.

Continuous Improvement

* Drive lessons learned initiatives and implement best practices across projects.
* Promote innovation, sustainability, and efficient project delivery methodologies.
* Mentor and support junior project managers and engineers where required.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, or a related discipline.
* Master's Degree or professional certifications (PMP, RICS, CIOB, PRINCE2) would be an advantage.

**Experience**

* Minimum **10–15 years** of experience in real estate development or project management.
* At least **5 years managing large-scale mixed-use, residential, hospitality, retail, or commercial developments in the UAE.**
* Previous experience working with a master developer or leading real estate developer is highly preferred.
* Strong understanding of the UAE development lifecycle, authority approvals, procurement, construction, and handover processes.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong knowledge of project management methodologies and construction practices.
* Experience managing consultants, contractors, and multidisciplinary teams.
* Excellent understanding of FIDIC contracts and contract administration.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Project, Primavera P6, Excel, and project reporting tools.
* Strong commercial awareness and financial management capabilities.
* Familiarity with UAE authority approval processes and local regulations.

**Core Competencies**

* Leadership and team management
* Strategic thinking
* Stakeholder management
* Project planning and execution
* Commercial acumen
* Negotiation and influencing skills
* Decision-making under pressure
* Risk management
* Quality and customer focus
* Excellent communication and presentation skills

To support a fair and consistent experience for all candidates, we ask that assessments and interviews are completed independently and without assistance from generative AI tools. This ensures we understand your strengths, your thinking, and how you approach real situations.

At Arada, you'll have the opportunity to contribute to projects that transform communities while working alongside talented professionals in a culture that values innovation, collaboration and continuous growth. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone has the opportunity to thrive and make a meaningful impact.

Arada is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from all qualified individuals and make employment decisions based on merit, experience and business needs.

jobs.title: Global Intelligence Manager
jobs.description:
The Global Intelligence Manager leads the Protective Intelligence mission within the Global Intelligence & Threat Analysis (GITA) team, serving as the enterprise lead for Protective Intelligence across The Walt Disney Company and affiliated business units. As a senior individual contributor, this role identifies emerging threats, assesses evolving risks, and produces finished intelligence supporting the protection of executives, talent, employees, productions, major events, executive travel, and other designated individuals.

Serving as the primary intelligence partner to Protective Services, the Protective Intelligence Manager transforms information from diverse internal, external, commercial, government, law enforcement, and open-source reporting into timely, analytically rigorous intelligence that enables proactive, risk-informed protective security decisions. The role also leads GITA's North America intelligence mission by continuously assessing the regional threat environment and evaluating developments involving targeted violence, grievance-driven actors, extremism, organized crime, geopolitical events, technology-enabled threats, and other issues that could affect Company personnel, operations, or reputation.

**Your Role on the Team**

As the Global Intelligence Manager, you are accountable for GITA's Protective Intelligence capability. You establish intelligence priorities, define intelligence requirements, guide collection and analytical efforts, and ensure intelligence products meet the highest standards of objectivity, quality, and operational relevance. You are responsible for ensuring GITA answers the organization's highest-priority protective intelligence requirements by identifying emerging threats, assessing evolving risks, and providing intelligence that informs protective planning, operational decision-making, and enterprise risk management.

**Every Day Is Different — Depending on the Day, You Will…**

* Lead GITA's Protective Intelligence capability, ensuring intelligence priorities align with evolving enterprise risks and Protective Services requirements.
* Operate with a high degree of autonomy, exercising sound judgment, ownership, and accountability while independently managing competing priorities and delivering intelligence products with minimal oversight.
* Develop and manage intelligence requirements and collection plans supporting executive protection, executive travel, major events, and other protective security missions.
* Identify, assess, and analyze threats affecting executives, talent, productions, major events, facilities, and other designated individuals.
* Produce Executive Intelligence Assessments, Major Event Risk Assessments, Executive Travel Risk Assessments, other finished intelligence supporting security decision-making.
* Continuously assess the North America threat environment, identifying changes in adversary capability, intent, or targeting and evaluating developments involving targeted violence, extremism, organized crime, civil unrest, geopolitical events, technology-enabled threats, and other emerging risks.
* Integrate intelligence from open-source, commercial, government, law enforcement, and internal sources to develop objective, comprehensive intelligence assessments.
* Brief senior Global Security leaders and operational partners on emerging threats, intelligence assessments, and strategic risk considerations to influence how executives understand and react to global events that could significantly impact the business.
* Build and maintain trusted partnerships across Protective Services, GSCC, GSI, Entertainment Security, business units, law enforcement, and external intelligence partners to ensure intelligence informs protective planning and operational decision-making.
* Partner with Global Security stakeholders to define data requirements and ensure information captured across shared enterprise platforms is structured and leveraged to support trend analysis, pattern identification, and the production of finished intelligence.

jobs.title: Global Mobility Program Manager, Tax
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **ABOUT THE TEAM**

**The Global Mobility team is responsible for getting Anduril talent where the mission needs it. We partner with leadership and cross-functional teams to help Anduril expand globally and staff new programs.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### **ABOUT THE JOB**

**As the Global Mobility Program Manager, Tax, you will develop the strategy and operating model for mobility tax at Anduril, spanning international and domestic assignments, cross-border transfers, business travel, and the reporting obligations that follow. In this individual contributor role, you will translate complex tax requirements into clear policies, durable controls, and practical guidance for the business, while supporting mobile employees directly through cost projections, mobility briefings, and the documentation that accompanies a move. Your technical judgment and project management skills will be essential in identifying tax implications early, keeping stakeholders informed, and ensuring compliance as the company expands into new jurisdictions globally.**

#### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Develop the global mobility tax framework, principles, governance, and service model in partnership with Corporate Tax teams.
* Build clear policies and decision frameworks for international and domestic business assignments, cross-border transfers, and other mobility scenarios.
* Support the global expansion strategy, ensuring compliance in international jurisdictions.
* Partner with Payroll, Corporate Tax, Finance, Legal, People, and business leaders to identify tax implications early and support sound workforce decisions.
* Support employees across the mobility lifecycle, including cost projections, assignment consultation and documentations, tax briefings, and coordination of tax return preparation with external advisors.
* Serve as the escalation point for employee and manager questions on mobility and assignment questions, providing clear, consistent guidance and a high-quality employee experience.
* Establish reporting, playbooks and decision frameworks.
* Manage external tax advisors and vendor partners, service quality, and delivery against agreed standards, timelines, and outcomes.
* Monitor regulatory and business changes, assess program impact, and continuously strengthen policies and controls.

* Minimum of 7+ years of experience in global mobility tax, expatriate tax, or business-traveler compliance.
* Experience in an in-house global mobility tax function, tax advisory firm, or both.
* Strong knowledge of individual income tax, payroll withholding and reporting, social security and totalization, tax equalization and protection, and permanent establishment risk.
* Proven experience building or scaling mobility tax policies, controls, and workflows for a globally operating company.
* Excellent project management skills with the ability to handle multiple priorities and lead cross-functional initiatives.
* Experience managing external tax advisors and implementing mobility tax technology.
* Highly organized, data-driven, and operationally sharp with strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to translate technical tax requirements into clear guidance for employees and business partners.
* Analytical thinker with a proactive mindset; thrives in fast-paced, evolving environments and meets tight deadlines.
* Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export controlled information or facilities

#### **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience supporting a defense, aerospace, or other highly regulated industry, including how export control and clearance requirements affect mobility decisions.
* Working knowledge of equity compensation taxation for mobile employees, equity tax treatments, and cross-border sourcing of RSUs and options.
* Hands-on experience with shadow payroll, hypothetical tax, and tax equalization settlements across multiple jurisdictions.

**About Monster Energy:**
-------------------------

* Ensure adherence and adoption of PMO governance standards and documentation requirements, right-sizing governance so it supports, rather than slows, agile delivery.
* Coordinate resource and capacity planning with Software Engineering managers to ensure project and sprint staffing needs are met.

* Support budget forecasting, tracking, and reconciliation for assigned projects.
* Drive retrospectives, post-implementation reviews, and lessons-learned sessions following major releases to support continuous improvement of engineering delivery and PMO practices.
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date project documentation in the PMO's project management system.
* Act as an ambassador for the PMO, project management, and agile delivery practices.

----------------

* **Education:** Bachelor's degree in Project Management, Business Administration, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field is required. Advanced degree preferred.
* **Experience:**
  + 5+ years of experience managing software development projects, such as websites, web applications, and custom-built applications. Preference within a formal PMO structure.
  + Proven experience delivering projects using both Waterfall and Agile/Scrum methodologies, including serving as Scrum Master or delivery lead for one or more development teams.
  + Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and modern development practices, including environments, code releases, CI/CD, and QA/testing processes.
  + Experience helping engineering teams establish or mature agile practices and delivery structure.
  + Familiarity with web technologies such as content management systems (CMS), APIs and integrations, and cloud hosting is a plus.
  + Demonstrated ability to operate independently with minimal oversight.
  + Proven ability to drive cross-functional alignment across business and IT and influence stakeholders and executives without direct authority.

jobs.description:
**About the Milken Institute**

The Milken Institute is a globally minded, publicly supported, non-partisan, and nonprofit think tank headquartered in Santa Monica, with offices in Washington, DC, New York, London, Abu Dhabi, and Singapore. For the past three decades, the Milken Institute has served as a catalyst for practical, scalable solutions to global challenges by connecting human, financial, and educational resources to those who need them. Guided by a conviction that the best ideas, under-resourced, cannot succeed, we conduct research and analysis and convene top experts, innovators, and influencers from different backgrounds and competing viewpoints. We leverage this expertise and insight to construct programs and policy initiatives. These activities are designed to help people build meaningful lives, in which they can experience health and well-being, pursue effective education and gainful employment, and access the resources required to create ever-expanding opportunities for themselves and their broader communities.

The Milken Institute’s events and programmatic activities, involve the exchange of ideas with leaders from around the world. The Institute hosts more than 200 events each year, with our annual flagship event, Global Conference, bringing together 4,500+ participants from around the world, featuring more than 900+ speakers throughout 200+ sessions over the course of the event.

**About The Position**

The Milken Institute is seeking a highly organized, analytical, and detail-oriented Senior Associate, Business Analyst to join the Project and Portfolio Management Office (PPMO) within the Technology Department. This role reports to the Product Manager, CRM & Data Analytics and supports the delivery, enhancement, and ongoing optimization of enterprise technology solutions, with a primary focus on Salesforce and related data analytics platforms.

The Business Analyst serves as a liaison between business stakeholders and technical teams, translating business needs into clear, actionable requirements and supporting the delivery of technology solutions that align with the Institute's operational objectives.

This is a hands-on role that combines business analysis, project coordination, and Agile delivery support. The Senior Associate will independently coordinate enhancement requests, to serve our operations teams, while supporting larger CRM and data analytics initiatives under the direction of the Product Manager.

Key responsibilities include gathering and documenting business requirements, developing process maps and functional specifications, creating test cases and coordinating user acceptance testing, maintaining Jira boards and facilitating Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning and backlog refinement.

Working closely with the Product Manager, business stakeholders, internal Technology teams, and external vendors, the Business Analyst will help ensure that requirements are clearly defined, work is appropriately tracked, and delivered solutions meet agreed-upon business needs.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, proactive, and analytical, with strong communication, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills. The successful candidate will be comfortable managing multiple assignments, facilitating discussions, translating technical information into accessible language for both technical and non-technical audiences, and following work through to completion.

The Senior Associate will collaborate with colleagues across Business Development, Events, Marketing, Operations, Programming, and other departments throughout the Institute.

The successful Business Analyst will maintain organized and accurate Jira boards, facilitate effective Agile ceremonies, support sprint execution, and ensure that system enhancements are validated against documented requirements through structured testing and business acceptance.

Over time, the Senior Associate will develop a deeper understanding of the Institute's Salesforce ecosystem, business processes, data structures, and enterprise technology standards. As their skills grow, they will take on increasingly complex enhancements, contribute recommendations for process improvements, and strengthen the efficiency and consistency of CRM and data analytics delivery.

Escalate changes or issues requiring Product Manager review.
* Agile and Scrum Facilitation: Serve as Scrum Master for assigned initiatives, facilitating sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and other Agile ceremonies. Support the Product Manager in maintaining an organized, prioritized, and actionable product backlog.

--------------------

The HRIS & Operations Analyst supports the configuration, maintenance, and optimization of Workday across multiple modules to ensure HR processes are efficient, accurate, and scalable. This role serves as a subject matter expert for Workday‑enabled HR business processes and system workflows, partnering closely with HR teams, managers, and team members to ensure effective and consistent system usage. This role is part of the HRIS & Operations team and reports to the Sr. Director of People Operations.

* Partner with IT and HRIS technical resources to support functional testing, validation, and troubleshooting of Workday integrations with internal and external systems
* Develop and share custom reports and calculated fields for users, maximizing efficiency by reusing existing reports and training users on modifying reports as needed
* Generate standard audit reports on daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly or annual basis
* Assist users within HR as needed to enable them to effectively/efficiently utilize all HR systems & modules

* Accurate and timely resolution of HRIS tickets

jobs.description:
**Description de l'entreprise**

Leader de l’Ingénierie et des IT Services, présent dans plus de 30 pays, le groupe ALTEN accompagne la stratégie de développement de ses clients dans les domaines de l’innovation, de la R&D et des systèmes d'information technologiques.

Plus qu’un poste, découvrez l’aventure qui vous attend au sein d’une entreprise engagée.

 **Description du poste**

Le Business Analyst Supply Chain accompagne les projets de transformation sur les activités Ventes, Distribution et Supply Chain opérationnelle.

Le poste offre une large exposition aux processus métier, à l'analyse de données et aux programmes internationaux, et constitue une base solide pour évoluer vers des fonctions en Supply Chain, gestion de projet ou transformation.

**Missions principales :**

**1. Analyse métier et compréhension des processus**

* Contribuer à l'analyse des processus Supply Chain et distribution de bout en bout.
* Documenter les pratiques métier actuelles et cibles.
* Recueillir et structurer les besoins auprès des différentes parties prenantes.
* Analyser les difficultés opérationnelles, les irritants et les opportunités d'amélioration.
* Préparer des recommandations pour faciliter la prise de décision.

**2. Transformation Ventes et Distribution**

* Contribuer aux initiatives d'amélioration de l'efficacité des processus de vente et de distribution.
* Accompagner la convergence des pratiques entre régions et organisations.
* Identifier les écarts de processus et les bonnes pratiques.
* Participer aux travaux liés à la gestion des commandes, à la distribution, à la logistique et à la livraison client.
* Suivre l'avancement des objectifs et des plans d'action de transformation.

**3. Analyse de données et suivi de la performance**

* Collecter, consolider et analyser les données opérationnelles et métier.
* Préparer des tableaux de bord, rapports et présentations pour le management.
* Contribuer à la définition d'indicateurs de performance.
* Traduire les données en recommandations concrètes.
* Suivre la performance et les résultats de la transformation.

**4. Collaboration transverse**

* Participer à des ateliers avec les métiers, les opérations, les régions et les équipes IT.
* Faciliter le partage d'information entre les parties prenantes.
* Contribuer à la coordination entre équipes métier et équipes projet.
* Contribuer à construire l'alignement autour d'objectifs et de priorités communs.
* Documenter les décisions, actions et résultats clés.

**5. Support projet et transformation**

* Contribuer à la planification, au suivi et au reporting du projet.
* Réaliser des présentations PowerPoint de qualité et des synthèses.
* Contribuer à la documentation projet et aux supports de gouvernance.
* Suivre les actions, dépendances et risques liés à la transformation.
* Assurer la traçabilité des décisions clés et des livrables.

**Qualifications :**

**Savoir être :**

* Esprit analytique.
* Curiosité et envie d'apprendre dans des environnements métier complexes.
* Approche structurée et organisée.
* Bonnes qualités de communication et aisance relationnelle.
* Capacité à travailler dans un environnement international et multiculturel.

jobs.title: Senior Business Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**About Rippling**
------------------

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the Role**
------------------

Business Operations is Rippling’s strike team for high-stakes, mission-critical challenges. We are the architects behind product development, go-to-market strategies, and scale operations across the entire company. Operating as the connective tissue for our compound startup, this small, elite unit brings structure to massive ambiguity and executes with relentless precision.

We need BizOps Managers who are world-class problem solvers, first-principles thinkers, and fearless operators. You won't just advise, you will build from 0-to-1, tackle the company’s biggest strategic bets, and partner directly with executive leadership. For high-performers, this role is the ultimate launchpad into executive leadership at an ultra-high-growth company.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Hunt Down High-Impact Problems: Identify critical business friction points, step into the fire, and build scalable solutions alongside senior leaders.
* Master the Revenue Engine: Architect and refine monetization, pricing, and packaging strategies to aggressively accelerate market dominance.
* Drive Cross-Functional Force-Multiplier Projects: Partner directly with Product, Engineering, and GTM teams to launch new initiatives and revolutionize operational systems.
* Own Your Data: Dig into raw databases, build custom SQL queries, construct dashboards, and extract actionable insight without needing a safety net.
* Set the Source of Truth: Collaborate with Finance and RevOps to define, standardize, and scale the operational metrics that steer the entire business.

**What You'll Need**
--------------------

* 8+ years of battle-tested experience in top-tier management consulting, BizOps, VC/PE, or as a startup founder. Exceptional talent with fewer years but a proven track record of rapid acceleration will be considered.
* Cross-functional mastery: A deep understanding of organizational dynamics in high-velocity tech environments.
* A data-first instinct: You instinctively open a spreadsheet, code a query, or analyze a dataset before building a slide deck.
* Extreme altitude-switching: Equally comfortable pitching strategy to C-suite executives as you are getting into the weeds with frontline operators.
* Relentless ownership and grit: You don't pass the mic or make excuses—you take full accountability and solve problems permanently.
* High-conviction autonomy: You thrive in chaos, make sound calls with incomplete data, and move fast without waiting for a playbook.

**Additional Information**

Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com

jobs.title: Immigration Program Manager (Operations)
jobs.description:
SummaryMeta is seeking an operations manager within its immigration program to lead the operating model for complex Talent Acquisition programs and the processes recruiting runs on. This person decides where the function should invest its process and program effort, sets the standards that recruiting teams work to, and carries the judgment calls on compliance risk, standardization, and sequencing. They will work from hiring priorities rather than defined project briefs, and they are accountable for outcomes across a stakeholder set they do not manage.The role also carries functional ownership of Meta's PERM recruitment process: a specialized, compliance-critical domain where this person is the company's internal authority on process and operations. We are looking for an experienced TA program and process owner who can hold that compliance line. Deep PERM expertise is valuable but can be built with support from the Immigration team and outside counsel.  
  
  

### **Immigration Program Manager (Operations) Responsibilities:**

* Portfolio and Operating Model Ownership
* Define, plan and execute complex TA programs and cross-functional initiatives. Identify which problems are worth solving, make the case for them, and sequence them against hiring priorities and capacity
* Set the operating model for how TA programs are scoped, governed, launched, and transitioned to steady state, and hold teams to it
* Own the relationship with outside counsel on PERM matters, setting the agenda on program-level strategy and taking a position on individual case strategy rather than relaying it
* Define the roles, responsibilities, and controls within the PERM recruitment process, then build the processes that drive sustained adherence across TA, Hiring Managers, and TA Operations
* Set the direction for the PERM Recruitment Enhancement initiative, including scope, risk appetite, and the standard the redesigned process must meet
* Serve as function manager for Meta's Talent Center PERM recruitment process, owning process health, compliance posture, and outcomes
* PERM Recruitment Program Ownership
* Initiate permanent residence cases with outside counsel and manage case progression against filing timelines
* Own the documentation standard for PERM (immigrant visa) filings, and ensure the process remains audit-ready by design rather than by remediation
* Act as the internal authority and escalation point for the Immigration team, foreign national employees, and HR partners on PERM questions
* Translate ambiguous or competing hiring priorities into a multi-quarter roadmap, and make the trade-off calls when priorities conflict
* Own the measures of success for the portfolio, including clearly defined success criteria and performance benchmarks
* Build mechanisms that let programs run without you: clear ownership, documentation, performance measures, and review cadence
* Process Architecture and Operational Excellence
* Own the end-to-end design of priority TA processes: workforce demand intake, requisition launch, sourcing, screening, interviewing, selection, offer management, preboarding, and recruiting operations
* Decide where processes should be standardized in ways that improve speed, quality, consistency and compliance and be able to defend those decisions to stakeholders
* Diagnose root causes behind systemic process failure rather than individual bottlenecks, and distinguish problems worth fixing from noise
* Set decision rights, handoffs, service expectations, escalation paths, and operating mechanisms across recruiting teams, including where those boundaries sit with Finance, Legal, and IT
* Establish the playbooks, SOPs, and governance practices that become the reference standard for recruiting execution
* Define the requirements that recruiting technology and ATS workflows must meet, and hold systems partners to them
* Build the data and feedback mechanisms that make continuous improvement a property of the function rather than a project activity
* Influence and Stakeholder Leadership
* Advise TA and business leaders on process and program strategy, including when their stated ask is not the right one
* Drive accountability across recruiters, coordinators, sourcers, hiring managers, interviewers, systems teams, Finance, Legal, and IT without direct authority
* Resolve contested design decisions across concurrent workstreams, and escalate with a recommendation rather than a question
* Raise the capability of other program and operations practitioners through mentoring, review, and reusable standards

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 12+ years of experience in recruiting operations, TA program management, HR operations, or a comparable program and process ownership role
* Track record of owning a program or process domain end to end as the accountable individual
* Experience setting direction in ambiguity: defining the problem, building the case for investment, and sequencing work against competing priorities
* Experience designing operational processes that were adopted beyond the team that built them, with measurable improvement
* Change management experience at a scale where adoption, not delivery, was the hard part
* Experience advising and influencing senior leaders, including redirecting a stated ask
* Experience owning the requirements and standards that recruiting technology and ATS workflows are held to, and using operational data to drive decisions
* Experience owning a compliance posture in a regulated or audit-exposed environment, including the judgment on where risk is acceptable
* Ability to make complex requirements legible to non-expert audiences and to senior decision makers

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Working knowledge of how PERM recruitment obligations interact with non-discrimination and IER requirements
* Direct PERM labor certification experience, including recruitment requirements, prevailing wage determinations, audit response, and documentati

jobs.description:
We're ALTEN Technology USA, an engineering company helping clients bring groundbreaking ideas to life—from advancing space exploration and life-saving medical devices to building autonomous electric vehicles. With 3,000+ experts across North America, we partner with leading companies in aerospace, medical devices, robotics, automotive, commercial vehicles, EVs, rail, and more.

As part of the global ALTEN Group—57,000+ engineers in 30 countries—we deliver across the entire product development cycle, from consulting to full project outsourcing.

When you join ALTEN Technology USA, you'll collaborate on some of the world's toughest engineering challenges, supported by mentorship, career growth opportunities, and comprehensive benefits. We take pride in fostering a culture where employees feel valued, supported, and inspired to grow.

**Workplace:** On-site, 5 days per week  
**Location:** Foster City, CA  
**Salary:** $115-130k

Manufacturing Operations is seeking a Program Manager to lead the implementation, integration, and continuous improvement of enterprise systems and business processes supporting manufacturing operations. This role will partner with Manufacturing Operations, Safety, HR, IT, Business Applications, and other cross-functional stakeholders to translate operational needs into scalable systems and processes. The ideal candidate combines strong program management and business process improvement capabilities with experience implementing enterprise systems, coordinating system integrations, driving organizational adoption, and delivering measurable operational outcomes.

**Responsibilities**  

* Lead end-to-end systems programs from current-state assessment and requirements gathering through solution design, implementation, deployment, and post-launch stabilization across Safety, Workforce Management, Quality Management, Learning Management, Asset Management, and related manufacturing operations systems.
* Partner with cross-functional stakeholders across Manufacturing Operations, Safety, HR, IT, Business Applications, and external vendors to translate operational needs into scalable system solutions and align priorities, requirements, and implementation plans.

Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) builds compliance programs and provides assurance for OpenAI’s technology, people, and products. As a Regulatory Compliance Program Manager, you will build and operate programs that turn regulatory requirements into clear responsibilities, effective processes, and evidence that can withstand external scrutiny.

jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
When you care deeply about the work you do, it’s rewarding to see it through from concept to completion. We partner with clients to provide both program management and construction management to strategize, plan, and implement projects that drive organizations forward. From hospitals and airports to university campuses, mass transit systems, water treatment facilities, mines, and wind farms, we've successfully managed thousands of projects.

Joining our team, turning visionary ideas into reality, will shape your future—and the future of your community.

We are strategizing, planning, and implementing projects that help clients achieve their organization’s objectives. Join our award-winning program management team and bring transformational project solutions to life.

Your Opportunity

As a Program Manager in Stantec you will lead a team and ensure adherence to the mission and objectives of the assigned program. You will have leadership responsibility for an integrated program team composed of both client and consultant staff. Duties of the Program Manager include client coordination, providing day-to-day guidance to multi-disciplined teams in a co-located Program Management Office (PMO) environment, typically located at a client facility. You will assist owners/clients with execution of the program, addressing strategy and delivery challenges and supporting internal client departments as may be required. You will oversee implementation of program delivery procedures and processes and confirm the program team’s performance against stated objectives.

The Program Manager oversees all services provided by an integrated team, including but not limited to: general program and project management services (scheduling, cost controls, risk management, change management, document control, interface management, engineering management etc.), preliminary design, subject matter expert technical support on projects, regulatory and permitting support, technical studies to support planning and design efforts, procurement of design and construction, construction management, operations & maintenance liaison, operations and maintenance readiness, community outreach and communications, project and program delivery strategy, funding strategy and training/knowledge transfer.

The Program Manager is responsible to track and manage delivery performance (cost, schedule, quality) on each project and the overall program.

Your Key Responsibilities

* Advising and assisting the client in the development, management, and execution of the program.
* Leading and overseeing the work of a multi-disciplinary client, consultant, and sub-consultant team.

* Overseeing the effective mobilization and set-up of the program in conjunction with the Stantec Mobilization Manager.
* Implementation of a robust governance structure to ensure adherence to a rigorous approach to project and program management.
* Implementation of program methodologies for project evaluation and selection of appropriate delivery models.
* Establishment of a performance reporting framework including the development of key performance indicators and associated reports/dashboards.
* Pro-actively identifying client needs and programmatic initiatives required to address potential program delivery risks and challenges.
