jobs.title: Security Analyst
jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------

Solairus Aviation is seeking a Senior Security Analyst to help protect the people, systems, and data behind its business aviation operations. Working as a peer alongside a second Security Analyst, this role shares responsibility for day-to-day security operations, including monitoring, alert triage, incident response, identity and access hygiene, and continuous improvement of the security program. The two analysts divide workload, cover for each other, and rotate after-hours responsibilities so the function runs consistently. This is a full-time, on-site position that works primarily standard business hours with participation in a shared after-hours on-call rotation for security incidents.

  

This position follows a hybrid schedule, with four days per week in the office and one day working from home.

**Essential Responsibilities/Duties**
-------------------------------------

Essential Duties

* Monitor, triage, and investigate security alerts across email, endpoint, identity, and cloud environments, escalating confirmed incidents according to established procedures.

* Participate in incident response, including containment, evidence collection, documentation, and post-incident review.

* Support identity and access management by reviewing access, maintaining role-based group assignments, and enforcing least-privilege and privileged access controls.

* Administer and tune security tooling to reduce noise and improve detection quality.

* Support email security, phishing response, and security awareness training.

* Assist with vulnerability management by tracking remediation of identified risks with IT partners.

* Maintain and improve security operations documentation, including SOPs, runbooks, and reporting metrics.

* Support compliance, audit, and eDiscovery requests as needed.

* Share an on-call rotation with the other Security Analyst and provide mutual coverage during absences.

* Partner with the Help Desk and broader IT team on security-related tickets and user guidance.

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Required Qualifications**

* 2–4 years of experience in security operations, IT security, or a related systems administration role with substantial security responsibilities.
* Working knowledge of security information and event management (SIEM), endpoint detection and response (EDR), identity provider/single sign-on (SSO), and email security platforms.
* Understanding of incident response fundamentals, common attack techniques, and log analysis.
* Strong written communication skills, including the ability to clearly document findings for technical teams and leadership.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating closely with a peer.
* Willingness to participate in a shared after-hours on-call rotation for security incidents.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Microsoft Sentinel, CrowdStrike Falcon, Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Purview, Delinea Secret Server/Privilege Manager, and Mimecast or comparable email security platforms.
* Familiarity with ticketing and incident management tools such as Zendesk and incident.io, as well as remote monitoring and management (RMM) platforms such as NinjaOne.
* Scripting or query experience using KQL, PowerShell, or Python.
* Industry certifications such as CompTIA Security+, CySA+, Microsoft SC-200, or GIAC GSEC/GCIH.
* Experience in aviation or another regulated environment with 24/7 operations.

jobs.description:
**Employee Applicant Privacy Notice**

**Who we are:**

Shape a brighter financial future with us.

Together with our members, we're changing the way people think about and interact with personal finance.

We're a next-generation financial services company and national bank using innovative, mobile-first technology to help our millions of members reach their goals. The industry is going through an unprecedented transformation, and we're at the forefront. We're proud to come to work every day knowing that what we do has a direct impact on people's lives, with our core values guiding us every step of the way. **Join us to invest in yourself, your career, and the financial world.**

#### **About the Role**

We're looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join the Business Intelligence team supporting Operations at SoFi. In this role, you will be the analytical engine supporting various Operations functions and initiatives, translating complex operational data into the insights and narratives that drive performance, service quality, and member experience.

This role sits within a broader data organization and supports stakeholders across Frontline and Backline Operations Teams, Workforce Management, and Customer Experience teams. You will help operational leaders better understand performance and identify bottlenecks by architecting comprehensive reporting frameworks and performing deep-dive diagnostic analyses to uncover the 'why' behind our metrics. **You will work across a diverse spectrum of operational datasets—including omnichannel contact data, IVR and chatbot interactions, customer experience (CX) sentiment metrics, and agent productivity performance.**

This is a strong fit for someone who thrives at sitting in the intersection of business operations and data analytics. You have a talent for building deep partnerships to understand operational needs, a passion for building reporting and analytical frameworks from the ground up, **and a track record of leveraging modern AI tools to work faster and smarter to pave the strategic roadmap for our Operations team.**

#### **What You'll Do**

* Serve as a thought partner to leadership — helping define what operational excellence looks like through data.
* Act as a reporting leader for Operations, setting standards for how SoFi measures, monitors, and **improves the member experience through data**.
* Own and drive reporting roadmaps, ensuring consistency, data accuracy, and scalability.
* Partner with Operations and CX leaders to define, monitor, and evolve key performance indicators (KPIs) that align with service excellence and business objectives.
* Lead the design, automation, and maintenance of Tableau reporting suite for Operations stakeholders, establishing a scalable 'source of truth' for operational performance and member experience metrics.
* **Partner with Data Engineering** to define business logic and data requirements, ensuring that upstream data collection is structured to support accurate, scalable downstream analytics.
* Develop reporting frameworks that unify data from multiple sources (**ex. customer experience metrics, contact center systems, agent productivity tracking, workforce management, and survey tools**) into cohesive, actionable insights.
* Lead deep-dive diagnostic analyses—including variance and root cause investigations—to uncover performance drivers and identify opportunities to reduce member friction or operational inefficiency.
* **Leverage cutting-edge AI tools (such as Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT, and AI coding assistants) to accelerate analytical workflows, automate query/script building, and deliver faster, smarter insights.**
* Proactively identify emerging trends and 'unknown unknowns' within operational data to alert leadership of risks or opportunities before they impact member experience or SLAs.
* Translate analytical findings into strategic recommendations that influence process design, workforce planning, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Lead data storytelling efforts, ensuring insights are communicated clearly and persuasively to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Data Science, and other BI teams to enhance data accessibility and automate recurring analytics.
* Mentor junior analysts and cross-functional partners on best practices for data-driven performance management, visualization, **and AI-assisted analytics**.

#### **What You'll Need**

* Bachelor's degree in Analytics, Statistics, Economics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field (Master's preferred).
* 5+ years of experience in data analytics, operations analytics, or business intelligence—ideally within a high-growth FinTech or regulated financial environment.
* **Proven experience analyzing complex operational datasets, such as contact data, customer experience data, and agent productivity metrics.**
* Advanced SQL skills with the ability to write complex, performant queries to extract insights from large-scale data warehouses.
* Advanced proficiency in **Tableau** (highly preferred) or other visualization tools (Looker, Power BI) to build scalable, automated dashboarding suites.
* **Demonstrated ability to be on the leading edge of modern AI analytics tools (e.g., Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT) to optimize workflows, code more efficiently, and deliver impactful insights faster.**
* Proven track record of "building from the ground up"—specifically designing new reporting frameworks, defining KPIs, and establishing data "sources of truth."
* Elite communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to simplify complex data and influence non-technical stakeholders and leadership.
* Strong business acumen and a passion for improving member experiences through data-driven decision-making.
* Comfort navigating ambiguity and working in fast-paced environments with evolving priorities and cross-functional dependencies.

#### **Nice to Have**

* Experience in business banking, commercial

new_jobs.description:
**It’s not just a job. It’s a mission.**

Altruix is a high-touch pharmacy dedicated to serving behavioral health and intellectual and developmental disability populations. Through our pharmacy expertise, and specialized packaging, we promote medication adherence and improve patient outcomes. Our services help clients take medications as prescribed while reducing administrative burden for providers. Altruix customers achieve measurable results, including 90% adherence rates and a 40% reduction in ER and hospital-related costs. Learn more at www.altruix.com.

Altruix is seeking a hands-on **Project Manager - Pharmacy Mergers & Acquisitions** to lead the execution of pharmacy acquisitions, integrations, De Novo builds, and relocations. This role translates approved growth opportunities into actionable project plans and drives execution from pre-close or initial planning through launch, stabilization, and transition to ongoing operations. The Project Manager coordinates cross-functional teams, maintains accountability for milestones and deliverables, identifies and escalates risks, and supports multiple concurrent projects while strengthening Altruix’s repeatable M&A and De Novo implementation processes.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Own integrated project plans, timelines, milestones, dependencies, budgets, and deliverables, ensuring clear ownership and accountability across workstreams

* Coordinate cross-functional work across Operations, Clinical and Quality, Legal and Compliance, Finance, HR, IT, Revenue Cycle, Payer, Licensing, Facilities, Procurement, Sales, Marketing, 340B, and Logistics

  

**M&A Integration:**

**OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY**

Fox News MediaFOX News Media operates the FOX News Channel (FNC), FOX Business Network (FBN), FOX News Digital, FOX News Audio, FOX News Books, the direct-to-consumer digital streaming services FOX Nation and FOX News International and the newly announced platform FOX Weather. Currently the number one network in all of cable, FNC has also been the most watched television news channel for 20 consecutive years, while FBN currently ranks among the top business channels on cable. Owned by FOX Corporation, FOX News Media reaches 200 million people each month.

**JOB DESCRIPTION**
-------------------

FOX News Media is seeking an experienced Broadcast & Media Technology Project Manager to lead complex technology initiatives across studio operations, live broadcast production, contribution/transmission networks, Media Asset Management (MAM) pipelines, and fast-turnaround content creation/editing environments.

This role will manage projects from initial discovery and technical requirements gathering through solution delivery, systems integration, testing, commissioning, and transition to 24/7 broadcast operations. The successful candidate will collaborate closely across broadcast engineering, studio operations, control rooms, post-production, editorial, transmission, infrastructure, cybersecurity, and external systems integrators/vendors.

The ideal candidate combines disciplined project management practices with a strong technical understanding of how broadcast content moves from field capture/ingest through studio control rooms, non-linear editing (NLE) suites, central MAM repositories, master control/playout, and multi-path transmission.

* Establish governance routines, engineering working sessions, steering committee reporting, and change-control decision forums.
* Coordinate workstreams across broadcast engineering, studio tech, transmission/traffic, newsroom operations, editing/post-production, IT infrastructure, and third-party vendors/systems integrators.
* Track delivery against broadcast milestones, schedule, budget, quality standards, and operational-readiness criteria.

* Manage MAM implementations, metadata schema standardization, ingest automation, nearline/deep archive tiers, LTO/cloud storage lifecycles, and media supply chain orchestration.
* Drive technical delivery for non-linear editing (NLE) platforms (Adobe Premiere, Avid Media Composer), shared production storage (SAN/NAS/Isilon/Avid NEXIS), fast-turnaround news editing, and transcode/QC workflows.
* Coordinate projects for playout automation, routing matrices (SDI and IP), primary/backup transmission paths, satellite uplink/downlink, terrestrial fiber circuits, and disaster recovery (DR) facilities.
* Facilitate technical integration between newsroom systems (e.g., iNEWS, ENPS), rundown automation, prompters, and playback servers.
* Translate operational and editorial requirements into clear engineering workstreams and technical deliverables.

* Coordinate comprehensive operational training and knowledge transfer for operators, directors, editors, engineers, and technicians prior to on-air cutover.

new_jobs.description:
Description:

**Primary Location: Rosslyn, VA**

**Clearance: Active Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility**

**Ability to work remotely: No**

Obsidian Solutions Group (OSG) is seeking an Intelligence Analyst II to support The Bureau of Diplomatic Security (DS). The Bureau of Diplomatic Security (DS) is the security and law enforcement arm of the U.S. Department of State (the Department). DS is a world leader in international investigations, threat analysis, cyber security, counterterrorism, security technology, and protection of people, property, and information. Its primary mission is to provide a safe and secure environment for the conduct of U.S. foreign policy. The Office of Security Technology (ST) supports the DS mission through the application and use of appropriate technical security countermeasures.

The Countermeasures Program (CMP) and Security Technology Operations (STO) divisions are operational components within ST. CMP is primarily responsible for worldwide technical countermeasures policy for the Department. Countermeasures policies enforce the protection of sensitive and classified information. CMP also manages the overseas technical surveillance countermeasures (TSCM) program.

**About Monster Energy:**
-------------------------

Forget about blending in. That's not our style. We're the risk takers, the trailblazers, the gamechangers. We're not perfect and we don't pretend to be. We're raw, unfiltered, and a bit unconventional. Our drive is just like our athletes, unrivaled. The power is in your hands to define what success looks like and where you want to take your career. It's not just about what we do, but about who we become along the way. We are much more than a brand here. We are a way of life, a mindset. Join us.

**A Day in the Life:**
----------------------

At Monster Energy, we move fast, push limits, and never settle for status quo — and our IT team is no different. We're looking for a Project Manager to join our IT PMO team and be the driving force behind the websites and custom applications our Software Engineering team builds to keep our business unstoppable. In this role, you'll lead software projects from kickoff through launch, working closely with engineers, designers, QA, and business stakeholders to keep work on track, on budget, and aligned with company goals. You'll know when a project calls for a structured waterfall plan and when it calls for Scrum — and you'll help shape and strengthen the agile practices our engineering teams use every day. You will operate independently with minimal oversight, driving cross-functional alignment across business and IT while influencing stakeholders and executives. If you enjoy solving problems, keeping people aligned, and helping great software ship smoothly, join us and help fuel what's next.

**The Impact You'll Make:**
---------------------------

* Plan and lead website and custom application projects, selecting and tailoring the right delivery approach (Waterfall, Agile/Scrum, or hybrid) based on scope, risk, timeline, and stakeholder needs.
* For waterfall projects, develop comprehensive project plans, including scope, schedule, budget, resource allocation, milestones, and risk management strategies.
* For agile projects, facilitate Scrum events — sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives — keeping teams focused, productive, and continuously improving.
* Partner with Software Engineering leadership to establish, standardize, and mature agile practices, including sprint cadence, estimation, definition of ready/done, user story standards, and team working agreements.
* Work with product owners and business stakeholders to translate business needs into well-defined epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria, and to maintain a clear, prioritized backlog.
* Lead cross-functional project teams composed of software engineers, UX/UI designers, QA, business stakeholders, and third-party agencies or vendors through all phases of the lifecycle — discovery, requirements, design, development, QA testing, UAT, release, and post-launch support.
* Coordinate release planning and deployments with engineering, QA, and DevOps, ensuring release readiness, go-live plans, rollback plans, and smooth handoff to support.
* Serve as the primary liaison between business sponsors, the Software Engineering team, and executive leadership, ensuring alignment on objectives, priorities, and expectations.
* Track and report project status using both traditional and agile metrics (e.g., milestones, budget performance, velocity, burndown/burnup, cycle time) and PMO standard tools and templates (e.g., dashboards, RAID logs, status reports).
* Identify and remove impediments, and manage project risks, issues, and cross-team dependencies, escalating appropriately and driving resolution in a timely manner.
* Manage scope and change control — evaluating formal change requests on waterfall projects and guiding backlog reprioritization on agile projects — with clear visibility into impact on schedule, cost, and resources.
* Ensure adherence and adoption of PMO governance standards and documentation requirements, right-sizing governance so it supports, rather than slows, agile delivery.
* Coordinate resource and capacity planning with Software Engineering managers to ensure project and sprint staffing needs are met.
* Manage agency, vendor, and contractor relationships, including scope adherence, deliverables, and contract compliance.
* Support budget forecasting, tracking, and reconciliation for assigned projects.
* Drive retrospectives, post-implementation reviews, and lessons-learned sessions following major releases to support continuous improvement of engineering delivery and PMO practices.
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date project documentation in the PMO's project management system.
* Act as an ambassador for the PMO, project management, and agile delivery practices.

**Who You Are:**
----------------

* **Education:** Bachelor's degree in Project Management, Business Administration, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field is required. Advanced degree preferred.
* **Experience:**
  + 5+ years of experience managing software development projects, such as websites, web applications, and custom-built applications. Preference within a formal PMO structure.
  + Proven experience delivering projects using both Waterfall and Agile/Scrum methodologies, including serving as Scrum Master or delivery lead for one or more development teams.
  + Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and modern development practices, including environments, code releases, CI/CD, and QA/testing processes.
  + Experience helping engineering teams establish or mature agile practices and delivery structure.
  + Familiarity with web technologies such as content management systems (CMS), APIs and integrations, and cloud hosting is a plus.
  + Demonstrated ability to operate independently with minimal oversight.
  + Proven ability to drive cross-functional alignment across business and IT and influence stakeholders and executives without direct authority.

OCTA is seeking an experienced professional to provide technical, administrative, financial, and operational analysis in support of Rail Transportation Services, including contract administration, regulatory reporting, performance analytics, and business process improvements.

The Senior level performs complex analytical assignments supporting rail operations, contract administration, regulatory compliance, budgeting, and performance reporting. The Principal level provides broader technical leadership and oversight of complex operational initiatives, contract strategy, performance improvements, and regulatory reporting.

This recruitment may be filled at either the Operations Analyst, Senior or Operations Analyst, Principal level based on the selected candidate's experience and qualifications.

**Operations Analyst, Principal** – This is an exempt position in salary grade 205: Min $101,275.20 – Mid $120,307.20 – Max $139,339.20/year. The starting salary will be within this range based on qualifications.

**What You'll Do**

* Administer and oversee rail transportation service contracts and third-party agreements, including invoice verification, tracking deliverables, and monitoring contractor performance.
* Support procurement activities, contract administration, and the development of contract strategies to meet operational needs.
* Develop and maintain electronic reporting databases, performance dashboards, and analytical tools to evaluate and improve contractor service performance.

* Provide technical expertise and guidance on operational analysis, contract administration, and performance improvement initiatives.

* Bachelor's degree in a related field or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Minimum of five years of professional administrative or analytical experience in transit project and program analysis, or four years of directly related professional experience in streetcar or rail operations, projects, or program analysis.
* Experience supporting contract administration, procurement activities, and regulatory reporting.
* Knowledge of operational performance analysis, database management, and reporting systems.
* Ability to analyze complex operational issues and recommend effective solutions.
* Experience supporting budget development, tracking expenditures, and preparing analytical reports.
* Strong organizational, analytical, written communication, and collaboration skills.

* Demonstrated experience providing technical leadership and oversight of complex operational programs and initiatives.
* Strong experience in contract administration, procurement, regulatory reporting, and contractor performance management.
* Expertise in operational performance analytics, database management, dashboard development, and business process improvements.
* Experience with federal and state transit reporting requirements, including the National Transit Database (NTD).
* Ability to resolve complex operational challenges, provide technical guidance, and develop strategic recommendations.
* Strong analytical, organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.

* Contribute to operational improvements that enhance service performance, efficiency, and compliance.
* Collaborate with internal departments, contractors, and transportation partners on important rail initiatives.
* Use data, analytics, and innovative solutions to influence operational decisions and improvements.

new_jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

Providing for loved ones, planning rewarding retirements, saving enough for whatever lies ahead – our policyholders count on us to be there when it matters most. It’s a big ask, but it’s one that we have the power to deliver when we work together. We collaborate and innovate – pushing one another to transform not just Pacific Life, but the entire industry for the better. Why? Because it’s the right thing to do. Pacific Life is more than a job, it’s a career with purpose. It’s a career where you have the support, balance, and resources to make a positive impact on the future – including your own.

We’re actively seeking a talented **Global Rotational Program Manager** to join our Early Career Talent team in Newport Beach, CA.

**About the Early Career Team**:  
The Early Career Talent Team is committed to building Pacific Life's future workforce by identifying, attracting, and developing high-potential early career talent. Through internships, rotational programs, university partnerships, and strategic talent initiatives, we create opportunities for students and recent graduates to gain meaningful experience, expand their professional networks, and make a lasting impact. Our team connects emerging talent with rewarding careers while helping Pacific Life cultivate the next generation of leaders, innovators, and industry experts.

As the Global Rotational Program Manager, you will lead the strategy, design, execution, and continuous improvement of early career Pacific Life’s rotational programs globally. This role is responsible for the participant experience from onboarding through final placement, ensuring programs deliver meaningful development opportunities while supporting enterprise talent.  
  
This position partners closely with business leaders, Talent Management, People Business Partners, and executive sponsors to create best-in-class rotational experiences. This role owns program operations, participant development, manager partnerships, talent reviews, program placements and program outcomes.  
  
Reporting to the Global Head of Early Career Talent Programs, the Global Rotational Program Manager will serve as the primary steward of Pacific Life’s rotational programs.

**How you’ll help move us forward:**

* **Program Strategy & Governance:** Lead the design, governance, and continuous improvement of rotational programs. Establish program standards, annual objectives, success metrics, and scalable processes that align with business and talent priorities.
* **Participant Experience & Development:** Manage the end-to-end participant experience including onboarding, orientation, learning curriculum, mentorship initiatives, executive exposure opportunities, cohort engagement, and career development programming.
* **Professional Development, Certification & Exam Readiness:** Partner with business leaders to develop and manage professional development pathways for rotational program participants. Drive certification, licensing, and exam preparation efforts including exam support programs by coordinating study resources, tracking progress toward credential milestones, facilitating learning opportunities, and helping participants successfully advance through required development benchmarks.
* **Rotation Planning & Stakeholder Management**: Partner with business leaders and rotation managers to identify rotational assignments, coordinate participant transitions, establish development objectives, and ensure participants gain meaningful experiences across the organization.
* **Talent Assessment and Placement:** facilitate placement discussions and recommendations while partnering with business leaders on final placement decisions, monitor participant development progress, and partner with leaders on readiness assessments and final placement decisions.
* **Program Operations, Analytics & Reporting:** Develop dashboards and track key metrics including retention, promotion, mobility, engagement, completion rates, and placement outcomes. Manage program communications, budgets, timelines, and continuous improvement efforts.
* **Early Career Community Support:** Serve as a key Early Career team presence in the Newport Beach office, supporting early career programming, networking opportunities and local talent initiatives in alignment with Pacific Life's broader early career strategy.

**The experience you bring:**

* 5+ years of experience in early career program management, talent management, learning and development, human resources, or a related field.
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, Organizational Development, or a related discipline.
* Demonstrated success in designing, managing, or supporting rotational, analyst, internship, or early career programs.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence senior leaders and manage relationships across a matrixed organization.
* Experience facilitating talent reviews, calibration discussions, and performance evaluations
* Strong project management, organization, communication, and presentation skills.
* Proficiency in data, reporting, analytics, and emerging technologies, including AI-enabled tools, to measure program effectiveness, improve operational efficiency, enhance participant experiences, and support data-driven decision-making.
* Experience working within a multi-location and global organization, with the ability to leverage technology and digital collaboration tools to support distributed program participants and stakeholders.

**About Rippling**
------------------

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the Role**
------------------

Business Operations is Rippling’s strike team for high-stakes, mission-critical challenges. We are the architects behind product development, go-to-market strategies, and scale operations across the entire company. Operating as the connective tissue for our compound startup, this small, elite unit brings structure to massive ambiguity and executes with relentless precision.

We need BizOps Managers who are world-class problem solvers, first-principles thinkers, and fearless operators. You won't just advise, you will build from 0-to-1, tackle the company’s biggest strategic bets, and partner directly with executive leadership. For high-performers, this role is the ultimate launchpad into executive leadership at an ultra-high-growth company.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Hunt Down High-Impact Problems: Identify critical business friction points, step into the fire, and build scalable solutions alongside senior leaders.
* Master the Revenue Engine: Architect and refine monetization, pricing, and packaging strategies to aggressively accelerate market dominance.
* Drive Cross-Functional Force-Multiplier Projects: Partner directly with Product, Engineering, and GTM teams to launch new initiatives and revolutionize operational systems.
* Own Your Data: Dig into raw databases, build custom SQL queries, construct dashboards, and extract actionable insight without needing a safety net.
* Set the Source of Truth: Collaborate with Finance and RevOps to define, standardize, and scale the operational metrics that steer the entire business.

**What You'll Need**
--------------------

* 8+ years of battle-tested experience in top-tier management consulting, BizOps, VC/PE, or as a startup founder. Exceptional talent with fewer years but a proven track record of rapid acceleration will be considered.
* Cross-functional mastery: A deep understanding of organizational dynamics in high-velocity tech environments.
* A data-first instinct: You instinctively open a spreadsheet, code a query, or analyze a dataset before building a slide deck.

**About the team**

Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) builds compliance programs and provides assurance for OpenAI’s technology, people, and products. We combine technical understanding with practical operations to reduce risk, support product and research teams, and produce reliable evidence of how our controls work.

**About the role**

As a Regulatory Compliance Program Manager, you will build and operate programs that turn regulatory requirements into clear responsibilities, effective processes, and evidence that can withstand external scrutiny.

Your work will focus on AI safety/security and content moderation, with privacy operations as an adjacent area. You will partner with Legal and the teams that build and operate our products to scope the work, maintain accurate control narratives, prepare regulatory responses, and lead external assessments for your assigned portfolio.

You should be comfortable owning delivery, explaining tradeoffs, and changing your recommendation when the evidence changes. Success means controls have accountable owners, evidence stays current, and teams can respond accurately without repeatedly rebuilding the same work. The initial portfolio and expectations will be agreed with the hiring manager.

**In this role, you will:**

* Lead an agreed portfolio of AI safety/security and content-compliance work, including programs associated with the EU AI Act, DSA, OSA, and SB 53, with Legal and relevant experts confirming applicable requirements.
* Translate requirements into scoped programs, operating processes, control and evidence responsibilities, milestones, and clear escalation paths.
* Build and maintain accurate control narratives and traceable evidence for regulatory requests, reporting, audits, and assessments.
* Lead preparation and delivery for external compliance assessments, coordinate the responsible teams, and track gaps through verified resolution or an explicitly owned decision.
* Prioritize the work that materially improves compliance outcomes and reduces risk; explain what should proceed, change, or wait and why.
* Develop evidence-backed recommendations with Legal, Product, Security, Safety, Integrity, Privacy, and other functional teams. Obtain decisions from the authorized owners for legal interpretation, external representations, and risk acceptance.
* Improve operational workflows for content and privacy compliance while keeping implementation and operation of controls with the appropriate functional owners.
* Simplify and automate repeated administrative work, test the results, and verify that the improvement is adopted and produces accurate, reliable outputs.
* Learn the GRC security-control environment and participate in the team’s on-call rotation, with scope and expectations explained during the hiring process.
* Communicate clearly, surface uncertainty early, incorporate feedback, and develop the domain knowledge needed for the next priority.

**You might thrive in this role if you:**

* Have practical experience building and operating AI safety/security and content-moderation programs, and can explain your own decisions, contribution, and results.
* Have used agentic tooling to automate and improve to scaled processes
* Understand relevant technical concepts across model evaluation, training and release, safety controls, content moderation, and post-launch operations, and can explain where specialist input is needed.
* Have a strong understanding of relevant AI safety, content, and privacy requirements, including the EU AI Act, DSA, OSA, and SB 53, and experience translating them into operating processes and controls with domain experts and Legal.
